<file path="components/AudioDirector.tsx">
'use client'
import { useEffect } from 'react'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { P, H } from '../lib/progress'
import { E } from '../lib/enter'
import { AUDIO } from '../lib/audio'
import { warnW, warnB } from '../lib/warn'
import { sstep } from '../lib/math'

// Feeds the state of the experience to the single audio engine every frame. The context only starts after a user gesture (browser autoplay rules).
export default function AudioDirector() {
  useEffect(() => {
    AUDIO.init()
    const go = () => AUDIO.resume(), ev = ['pointerdown', 'keydown', 'touchend']
    ev.forEach((e) => addEventListener(e, go, { passive: true }))
    let pp = 0, pr = 0
    const fn = () => {
      const p = P.value, r = P.r, w = warnW()
      AUDIO.update({ started: P.introStart > 0, p, r, w, B: warnB(w), rev0: sstep(0.34, 0.78, r), rev1: sstep(0.4, 0.86, r), hover: H.i, room: E.room, booked: E.booked, d: E.d, k: E.k })
      if ((pp < 0.72 && p >= 0.72) || (pr < 0.015 && r >= 0.015 && p > 0.95) || (pr < 0.55 && r >= 0.55)) AUDIO.whoosh('air', 1.2) // camera: toward the opening, out of the brain, toward the rooms
      pp = p; pr = r
    }
    gsap.ticker.add(fn)
    return () => { gsap.ticker.remove(fn); ev.forEach((e) => removeEventListener(e, go)); AUDIO.dispose() }
  }, [])
  return null
}
</file>

<file path="components/Booking.tsx">
'use client'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { SLOTS, getAvailability, submitBooking } from '../lib/booking'
import { rooms } from '../lib/content'

const iso = (d: Date) => `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`
const DAYS = () => Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() + i); return { iso: iso(d), wd: d.toLocaleDateString('en', { weekday: 'short' }).toUpperCase(), n: String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0') } })

function useForm(room: string) {
  const [date, setDate] = useState(iso(new Date())), [time, setTime] = useState(''), [people, setPeople] = useState(2), [name, setName] = useState(''), [email, setEmail] = useState('')
  const [slots, setSlots] = useState<string[]>([]), [avail, setAvail] = useState<'checking' | 'done'>('checking'), [done, setDone] = useState(false), [busy, setBusy] = useState(false)
  const check = useCallback(async () => { setAvail('checking'); setTime(''); const s = await getAvailability(room, date); setSlots(s); setAvail('done') }, [room, date])
  useEffect(() => { check() }, [check])
  const valid = avail === 'done' && !!time && !!name.trim() && /\S+@\S+\.\S+/.test(email)
  const submit = async () => { if (!valid || busy) return; setBusy(true); const r = await submitBooking({ room, date, time, people, name, email }); setBusy(false); setDone(r.ok) }
  return { date, setDate, time, setTime, people, setPeople, name, setName, email, setEmail, slots, avail, check, done, busy, valid, submit, days: DAYS() }
}
type F = ReturnType<typeof useForm>
const status = (f: F) => (f.avail === 'checking' ? 'CHECKING…' : `${f.slots.length} SLOT${f.slots.length === 1 ? '' : 'S'} OPEN`)
const dl = (n: number) => ({ animationDelay: `${n * 0.16}s` })

// CANTEEN 66 — an abandoned service station powering back on: riveted steel, stencilled controls with lamps, a mechanical group counter, flickering start-up.
function Canteen({ onLeave }: { onLeave: () => void }) {
  const f = useForm(rooms[0].name)
  return (
    <div className="bk cn-bg" role="dialog" aria-label="Canteen 66 entry log">
      <span className="cn-stencil" aria-hidden>66</span>
      <button onClick={onLeave} className="cn-exit po" style={dl(1)}>Exit ✕</button>
      <div className="relative mx-auto grid min-h-full max-w-6xl gap-14 px-[5vw] py-[11vh] md:grid-cols-[0.85fr_1.25fr]">
        <div>
          <p className="po cn-k" style={dl(1)}>Field kitchen unit 66</p>
          <h2 className="po cn-title" style={dl(2)}>Entry<br />log</h2>
          <dl className="po cn-dl mt-10" style={dl(4)}><dt>Location status</dt><dd>Closed</dd><dt>Access</dt><dd>By reservation</dd><dt>Group</dt><dd>2–6</dd><dt>Duration</dt><dd>60 min</dd></dl>
        </div>
        {f.done ? (
          <div className="po self-center" style={dl(1)}><p className="cn-title !text-[3.4rem]">Logged</p><p className="cn-k mt-4">{f.date} · {f.time} · {f.people} persons — confirmation to follow</p></div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid gap-9">
            <section className="po" style={dl(3)}><h3 className="cn-sec">01 · Date</h3>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">{f.days.map((d) => <button key={d.iso} onClick={() => f.setDate(d.iso)} className={`cn-tab ${f.date === d.iso ? 'on' : ''}`}><i className="lamp" /><span>{d.wd}</span><b>{d.n}</b></button>)}</div>
              <input aria-label="Other date" className="cn-in mt-3 !w-auto" type="date" min={iso(new Date())} value={f.date} onChange={(e) => f.setDate(e.target.value)} />
            </section>
            <section className="po" style={dl(5)}><h3 className="cn-sec">02 · Time <em>{status(f)}</em></h3>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">{SLOTS.map((s) => <button key={s} disabled={!f.slots.includes(s)} onClick={() => f.setTime(s)} className={`cn-tab ${f.time === s ? 'on' : ''}`}><i className="lamp" /><b>{s}</b></button>)}</div>
              <button onClick={f.check} className="cn-btn mt-3">Check availability</button>
            </section>
            <section className="po" style={dl(7)}><h3 className="cn-sec">03 · Group</h3>
              <div className="flex items-stretch gap-3"><button className="cn-btn !px-5 !text-lg" aria-label="Fewer" onClick={() => f.setPeople((p) => Math.max(2, p - 1))}>−</button><div className="cn-dial" aria-live="polite">{f.people}</div><button className="cn-btn !px-5 !text-lg" aria-label="More" onClick={() => f.setPeople((p) => Math.min(6, p + 1))}>+</button></div>
            </section>
            <section className="po grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2" style={dl(9)}>
              <label><span className="cn-sec">Name</span><input className="cn-in" value={f.name} onChange={(e) => f.setName(e.target.value)} autoComplete="name" /></label>
              <label><span className="cn-sec">Email</span><input className="cn-in" type="email" value={f.email} onChange={(e) => f.setEmail(e.target.value)} autoComplete="email" /></label>
            </section>
            <button onClick={f.submit} disabled={!f.valid || f.busy} className="po cn-reserve" style={dl(11)}>{f.busy ? 'Logging…' : 'Reserve'}</button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

// DEAR MOTHER — buried: soil, roots framing the edges, the last light draining away, controls that resolve slowly out of the dark like something uncovered.
function Mother({ onLeave }: { onLeave: () => void }) {
  const f = useForm(rooms[1].name)
  return (
    <div className="bk dm-bg" role="dialog" aria-label="Dear Mother reservation">
      <svg className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 h-full w-full" viewBox="0 0 1000 1000" preserveAspectRatio="none" fill="none" stroke="#1d130b" strokeLinecap="round" aria-hidden>
        {['M0,0 C90,220 10,420 130,720 S60,900 110,1000', 'M1000,0 C900,260 990,460 860,720 S940,900 890,1000', 'M0,300 C120,330 160,420 260,430 S300,520 360,560', 'M1000,520 C880,560 840,640 760,650 S700,740 640,760', 'M300,0 C320,60 280,120 330,170 S380,230 420,250', 'M700,1000 C690,930 740,880 700,820', 'M110,720 C200,700 230,760 320,790'].map((d, i) => <path key={i} d={d} strokeWidth={i < 2 ? 11 : i < 5 ? 5 : 3} className="root" style={{ animationDelay: `${i * 0.5}s` }} />)}
      </svg>
      {Array.from({ length: 22 }, (_, i) => <i key={i} className="pointer-events-none absolute rounded-full bg-[#4a3826]" style={{ left: `${(i * 37) % 100}%`, top: `${(i * 53) % 100}%`, width: 2 + (i % 3), height: 2 + (i % 3), opacity: 0.5, animation: `drift ${9 + (i % 5)}s ease-in-out ${i * 0.4}s infinite` }} />)}
      <div className="dm-dim" />
      <button onClick={onLeave} className="dm-in fixed right-[4vw] top-6 z-10 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.5em] text-bone/55 hover:text-bone" style={dl(10)}>↑ Return</button>
      <div className="relative mx-auto grid min-h-full max-w-5xl content-center gap-12 px-[6vw] py-[12vh] md:grid-cols-[1fr_1fr]">
        <div>
          <p className="dm-in font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.5em] text-[#7f98a6]" style={dl(5)}>Site status: undocumented</p>
          <h2 className="dm-in dm-title mt-6" style={dl(7)}>Dear<br />Mother</h2>
          <p className="dm-in mt-8 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase leading-[2.1] tracking-[0.3em] text-bone/45" style={dl(9)}>Depth −3.4 m<br />Access by reservation<br />Group 2–6 · 75 min</p>
        </div>
        {f.done ? (
          <div className="dm-in self-center" style={dl(1)}><p className="dm-title !text-5xl">Recorded.</p><p className="mt-4 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-bone/55">{f.date} · {f.time} · {f.people} persons</p></div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid gap-9 self-center font-mono text-[11px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em]">
            <section className="dm-in" style={dl(9)}><h3 className="dm-sec">Date</h3>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-5 gap-y-2">{f.days.map((d) => <button key={d.iso} onClick={() => f.setDate(d.iso)} className={`dm-opt ${f.date === d.iso ? 'on' : ''}`}>{d.wd} {d.n}</button>)}</div>
            </section>
            <section className="dm-in" style={dl(11)}><h3 className="dm-sec">Time <em>{status(f)}</em></h3>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-6 gap-y-2">{SLOTS.map((s) => <button key={s} disabled={!f.slots.includes(s)} onClick={() => f.setTime(s)} className={`dm-opt ${f.time === s ? 'on' : ''}`}>{s}</button>)}</div>
              <button onClick={f.check} className="dm-opt mt-3 !text-[9px]">Check availability</button>
            </section>
            <section className="dm-in" style={dl(13)}><h3 className="dm-sec">Group</h3>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-7"><button className="dm-opt !text-xl" aria-label="Fewer" onClick={() => f.setPeople((p) => Math.max(2, p - 1))}>−</button><span className="font-display text-5xl font-light not-italic text-bone" aria-live="polite">{f.people}</span><button className="dm-opt !text-xl" aria-label="More" onClick={() => f.setPeople((p) => Math.min(6, p + 1))}>+</button></div>
            </section>
            <section className="dm-in grid gap-5" style={dl(15)}>
              <label><span className="dm-sec">Name</span><input className="dm-in-field" value={f.name} onChange={(e) => f.setName(e.target.value)} autoComplete="name" /></label>
              <label><span className="dm-sec">Email</span><input className="dm-in-field" type="email" value={f.email} onChange={(e) => f.setEmail(e.target.value)} autoComplete="email" /></label>
            </section>
            <button onClick={f.submit} disabled={!f.valid || f.busy} className="dm-in dm-go" style={dl(17)}>{f.busy ? '…' : 'Reserve'}</button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
export default function Booking({ room, onLeave }: { room: number; onLeave: () => void }) { return room === 0 ? <Canteen onLeave={onLeave} /> : <Mother onLeave={onLeave} /> }

'use client'
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react'
import { useGLTF } from '@react-three/drei'
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { P, S } from '../lib/progress'
import { sstep, bell } from '../lib/math'
import { buildPieces, Layer } from '../lib/pieces'
import { organic } from '../lib/materials'

const TARGET = 2.6 // world-space size of the brain
const mk = (o: THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterialParameters) => organic(new THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial({ side: THREE.DoubleSide, roughness: 0.66, clearcoat: 0.1, clearcoatRoughness: 0.5, specularIntensity: 0.45, sheen: 0.2, ...o }))
// Overlapping neighbouring meshes z-fight, so their colours are kept close: contrast between them reads as speckle.
function makeMaterials() {
  const cortex = [0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => mk({ color: new THREE.Color('#977872').offsetHSL(0, 0, (i - 1.5) * 0.006), sheenColor: new THREE.Color('#a8837b'), sheenRoughness: 0.7 }))
  const sulcus = mk({ color: '#86665f', sheenColor: new THREE.Color('#8f6b64'), sheenRoughness: 0.8 })
  const m: Record<Exclude<Layer, 'hidden' | 'cortex'>, THREE.Material> = {
    cerebellum: mk({ color: '#8a6c64', roughness: 0.74 }),
    deep: mk({ color: '#836a63', roughness: 0.55, clearcoat: 0.2 }),
    tract: mk({ color: '#b5a899', roughness: 0.7 }),
    vessel: mk({ color: '#5a1520', roughness: 0.5, clearcoat: 0.3, clearcoatRoughness: 0.4 }),
    nerve: mk({ color: '#b8ad90', roughness: 0.65 }),
    amygdala: mk({ color: '#8a5650', roughness: 0.6 }),
  }
  return { cortex, sulcus, m }
}

export default function BrainModel({ onReady }: { onReady: () => void }) {
  const { scene } = useGLTF('/models/brain.glb', '/draco/')
  const group = useRef<THREE.Group>(null)
  const smooth = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 })
  const rig = useMemo(() => {
    const built = buildPieces(scene)
    const mats = makeMaterials()
    // ~1.3M triangles: drop the thin nerve fibres on touch devices to protect frame rate
    if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches) built.pieces.forEach((p) => { if (p.layer === 'nerve') p.mesh.visible = false })
    built.pieces.forEach((p) => { p.mesh.material = p.layer === 'cortex' ? (/sulc/i.test((p.mesh.userData.name ?? p.mesh.name) as string) ? mats.sulcus : mats.cortex[Math.floor(p.h * 4) % 4]) : mats.m[p.layer as keyof typeof mats.m]; p.mesh.frustumCulled = false })
    return { ...built, mats }
  }, [scene])
  const s = TARGET / rig.size
  useEffect(() => { S.pieces = rig.pieces; S.norm = { c: rig.center, s: TARGET / rig.size }; onReady(); return () => { rig.mats.cortex.forEach((m) => m.dispose()); rig.mats.sulcus.dispose(); Object.values(rig.mats.m).forEach((m) => m.dispose()) } }, [rig, onReady])

  const allMats = useMemo(() => [...rig.mats.cortex, rig.mats.sulcus, ...Object.values(rig.mats.m)] as THREE.Material[], [rig]), lastFade = useRef(1)
  const q = useMemo(() => new THREE.Quaternion(), [])
  const e = useMemo(() => new THREE.Euler(), [])
  const tmp = useMemo(() => new THREE.Vector3(), []), fd = useMemo(() => new THREE.Vector3(), []), wp = useMemo(() => new THREE.Vector3(), [])
  useFrame((state) => {
    const g = group.current; if (!g) return
    g.visible = P.r < 0.12; if (!g.visible) { S.remaining = 0; return }
    const fade = 1 - sstep(0, 0.1, P.r); if (Math.abs(fade - lastFade.current) > 0.002) { lastFade.current = fade; allMats.forEach((m) => { m.transparent = fade < 0.999; m.opacity = fade; m.depthWrite = fade >= 0.999 }) } // last fragments dissolve while the alarm runs // the real brain is removed from the scene after the exit; the scan is a separate system
    const p = P.value, t = state.clock.elapsedTime, red = P.reduced
    if (p > 0.6) { let n = 0; state.camera.getWorldDirection(fd); for (const pc of rig.pieces) { pc.mesh.getWorldPosition(wp); wp.sub(state.camera.position); const d = wp.length(); if (d < 12 && d > 0.05 && wp.dot(fd) / d > 0.35) n++ } S.remaining += (n / rig.pieces.length - S.remaining) * 0.15 } else S.remaining = 1
    smooth.current.x += (P.mx - smooth.current.x) * 0.04; smooth.current.y += (P.my - smooth.current.y) * 0.04
    const settle = sstep(0.3, 0.6, p), live = 1 - settle
    g.rotation.y = (0.4 - 0.25 * p + (red ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.05) * 0.05 + smooth.current.x * 0.03)) * live
    g.rotation.x = (red ? 0 : smooth.current.y * 0.03) * live
    g.position.y = 0.22 * live
    g.scale.setScalar(1 + 0.12 * sstep(0.1, 0.5, p))
    const tremAmp = red ? 0 : bell(0.15, 0.28, 0.46, p)
    for (const pc of rig.pieces) {
      const u = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (p - pc.start) / pc.dur))
      const ease = u * u * u * (u * (6 * u - 15) + 10)
      const drift = Math.max(0, p - pc.start - pc.dur) * 0.5
      tmp.copy(pc.dir).multiplyScalar(pc.dist * (ease + drift)).add(pc.home)
      if (!red) {
        const pre = sstep(pc.start - 0.1, pc.start, p) * (1 - sstep(pc.start, pc.start + 0.02, p))
        const a = pc.tremble * (tremAmp * 0.5 + pre * 1.5)
        if (a > 0) tmp.set(tmp.x + Math.sin(t * 38 + pc.h * 40) * a, tmp.y + Math.sin(t * 41 + pc.h * 70) * a, tmp.z + Math.sin(t * 35 + pc.h * 90) * a)
      }
      pc.mesh.position.copy(tmp)
      const sp = ease + drift * 0.5
      e.set(pc.spin.x * sp, pc.spin.y * sp, pc.spin.z * sp); q.setFromEuler(e); pc.mesh.quaternion.copy(q)
    }
  })
  return (
    <group ref={group}>
      <group scale={s} position={[-rig.center.x * s, -rig.center.y * s, -rig.center.z * s]}>
        <primitive object={scene} />
      </group>
    </group>
  )
}
</file>

'use client'
import { Suspense, useRef } from 'react'

import SpecimenRoom from './SpecimenRoom'
import { P, FOCUS, LOAD } from '../lib/progress'
import { bell } from '../lib/math'

const OFF = new THREE.Vector2(0, 0)
function Fx() {
  const ca = useRef<any>(null)
  useFrame(() => { const a = P.reduced ? 0 : 0.0007 * bell(0.38, 0.45, 0.56, P.value); ca.current?.offset?.set(a, a) })
  return (
    <EffectComposer multisampling={4}>
      <DepthOfField target={FOCUS} focalLength={0.05} bokehScale={2} height={720} />
      <ChromaticAberration ref={ca} offset={OFF} radialModulation={false} modulationOffset={0} />
      <ToneMapping mode={ToneMappingMode.ACES_FILMIC} />
    </EffectComposer>
  )
}
export default function BrainScene({ onReady }: { onReady: () => void }) {
  const coarse = typeof window !== 'undefined' && matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches
  return (
    <Canvas eventSource={document.body} eventPrefix="client" dpr={coarse ? [1, 1.5] : [1, 1.75]} camera={{ fov: 38, near: 0.08, far: 60, position: [0, 0.1, 6.0] }}
      gl={{ antialias: !coarse, powerPreference: 'high-performance' }}
      onCreated={({ gl, scene }) => { LOAD.canvas = true; gl.setClearColor('#000000'); gl.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping; gl.toneMappingExposure = 1.1; scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2('#000000', 0.035) }}>
      <Suspense fallback={null}><BrainModel onReady={onReady} /></Suspense>
      <Suspense fallback={null}><Wordmark3D /></Suspense>
      <CameraRig /><Lights /><Dust count={coarse ? 200 : 460} /><LabelDriver /><SpecimenRoom /><Suspense fallback={null}><RoomWorlds /></Suspense>
      {!coarse && <Fx />}
    </Canvas>
  )
}

<file path="components/CameraRig.tsx">
'use client'
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { P, FOCUS, H } from '../lib/progress'
import { E, EF, enterCam } from '../lib/enter'
import { sstep, bell } from '../lib/math'

// 11 evenly spaced keyframes (every 10% of scroll). Spacing between points sets the pace; Catmull-Rom keeps it fluid.
const K: [number[], number[]][] = [
  [[0, 0.1, 6.0], [0, 0, 0]], [[-0.2, 0.15, 5.6], [0, 0, 0]], [[0.3, 0.25, 4.8], [0, 0, 0]], [[0.55, 0.2, 4.0], [0.4, 0, 0]],
  [[-0.4, 0.4, 3.7], [0.2, 0, 0]], [[-0.15, 0.3, 3.4], [0, 0, 0]], [[0.1, 0.1, 2.8], [0, 0, -0.5]], [[0, 0, 1.7], [0, 0, -1.5]],
  [[0, 0, 0.2], [0, 0, -2.5]], [[0, 0, -1.8], [0, 0, -5]], [[0, 0.1, -5.5], [0, 0.1, -10]],
]
const posC = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(K.map((k) => new THREE.Vector3(...k[0])), false, 'centripetal')
const lookC = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(K.map((k) => new THREE.Vector3(...k[1])), false, 'centripetal')
const a = new THREE.Vector3(), b = new THREE.Vector3(), RL = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.1, -30), hx = { v: 0 }

export default function CameraRig() {
  useFrame((state) => {
    const { camera, size, clock, scene } = state, p = P.value, t = clock.elapsedTime, red = P.reduced
    posC.getPoint(p, a); lookC.getPoint(p, b)
    const aspect = size.width / size.height
    if (aspect < 1.1 && a.z > 0) a.z *= 1 + (1.1 - aspect) * (1 - sstep(0.5, 0.65, p)) // keep brain framed on portrait screens
    const w = 1 - 0.85 * sstep(0.55, 0.75, p)
    if (!red) { a.x += P.mx * 0.22 * w + Math.sin(t * 0.2) * 0.03; a.y += -P.my * 0.14 * w + Math.cos(t * 0.17) * 0.02; b.x += P.mx * 0.05 }
    const r = P.r
    if (r > 0) { const u = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (r - 0.25) / 0.75)), zt = 2 * sstep(0, 0.25, r) + 13.5 * u * (2 - u), sw = -0.9 * bell(0.6, 0.7, 0.8, r) + 0.9 * bell(0.75, 0.85, 0.95, r), dr = sstep(0, 0.1, r) * (1 - sstep(0.15, 0.25, r)); a.z -= zt; a.x += sw + Math.sin(r * 14) * 0.1 * dr; a.y += 0.6 * sstep(0.6, 1, r); hx.v += ((H.i < 0 ? 0 : H.i ? 0.5 : -0.5) - hx.v) * 0.04; b.lerp(RL, sstep(0.25, 0.6, r)); b.x += hx.v * sstep(0.9, 1, r) + sw * 0.7 }
    if (E.room < 0) { E.cur.a.copy(a); E.cur.b.copy(b) } else enterCam(a, b, t)
    const roll = red ? 0 : bell(0.68, 0.78, 0.9, p) * 0.12
    camera.up.set(Math.sin(roll), Math.cos(roll), 0)
    camera.position.copy(a); camera.lookAt(b)
    const dir = b.clone().sub(a).normalize(), into = sstep(0.58, 0.72, p), d = a.length() * (1 - into) + (2.2 + 4 * sstep(0.88, 1, p)) * into
    FOCUS.copy(a).addScaledVector(dir, d)
    if (r > 0) FOCUS.lerp(RL, sstep(0.25, 0.6, r))
    if (E.room >= 0) FOCUS.copy(EF)
    const fv = 38 + 16 * E.fov; const pc = camera as THREE.PerspectiveCamera; if (Math.abs(pc.fov - fv) > 0.01) { pc.fov = fv; pc.updateProjectionMatrix() }
    const fog = scene.fog as THREE.FogExp2 | null
    if (fog) fog.density = (0.035 + 0.2 * bell(0.68, 0.82, 0.95, p)) * (1 - 0.6 * sstep(0.3, 0.7, r)) + E.dark * 0.6
  })
  return null
}

<file path="components/Canteen.tsx">
'use client'
import { useMemo } from 'react'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { RoundedBox } from '@react-three/drei'
import { bake, fbm, rnd } from '../lib/procTex'
import { sstep as sm } from '../lib/math'
import { E } from '../lib/enter'

const mix = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => a + (b - a) * t
// CANTEEN 66 — an abandoned wheeled field kitchen: chassis, axle, two spoked wheels, firebox casing with door + hatch, kettle with domed lid and handles, chimney, drawbar with ring and prop. Rust/peeling-paint maps are baked procedurally; "66" is a worn stencil decal on the casing.
export default function Canteen() {
  const o = useMemo(() => {
    const { map, orm, bump } = bake(512, 512, (u, v) => {
      const a = fbm(u * 7, v * 7, 1), b = fbm(u * 24, v * 24, 2), c = fbm(u * 3, v * 3, 3)
      const paint = sm(0.42, 0.6, c - 0.2 * a + 0.15), rust = sm(0.35, 0.7, a * 0.7 + b * 0.45), g = 0.55 + 0.45 * fbm(u * 50, v * 50, 5)
      return [mix(mix(0.22, mix(0.36, 0.5, b), rust), 0.2 * (0.7 + 0.5 * b), paint) * g, mix(mix(0.21, mix(0.17, 0.26, b), rust), 0.22 * (0.7 + 0.5 * b), paint) * g, mix(mix(0.2, mix(0.07, 0.1, b), rust), 0.14, paint) * g, paint ? 0.7 : mix(0.35, 0.9, rust), paint ? 0.1 : mix(0.9, 0.25, rust), 0.5 + (b - 0.5) * 0.5 + rust * 0.15]
    }, (ctx, which) => { for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) { ctx.strokeStyle = which === 'map' ? 'rgba(170,165,150,.25)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,.3)'; ctx.lineWidth = 0.6 + rnd(i, 4); ctx.beginPath(); const x = rnd(i, 1) * 512, y = rnd(i, 2) * 512, l = 20 + rnd(i, 3) * 80, an = rnd(i, 5) * 3.14; ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x + Math.cos(an) * l, y + Math.sin(an) * l); ctx.stroke() } })
    const rust = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map, roughnessMap: orm, metalnessMap: orm, roughness: 1, metalness: 1, bumpMap: bump, bumpScale: 3 })
    const dc = document.createElement('canvas'); dc.width = 512; dc.height = 256; const d = dc.getContext('2d')!
    d.fillStyle = 'rgba(205,196,165,.85)'; d.font = '190px Impact, "Arial Narrow", sans-serif'; d.textAlign = 'center'; d.textBaseline = 'middle'; d.fillText('66', 256, 118)
    d.font = '34px Impact, sans-serif'; d.fillText('CANTEEN', 256, 222)
    d.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'; for (let i = 0; i < 1400; i++) { d.globalAlpha = 0.3 + rnd(i, 6) * 0.6; d.fillRect(rnd(i, 7) * 512, rnd(i, 8) * 256, 2 + rnd(i, 9) * 8, 2 + rnd(i, 10) * 5) }
    const dt = new THREE.CanvasTexture(dc); dt.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace
    return { rust, dark: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#171615', metalness: 0.8, roughness: 0.6 }), tire: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#0f0e0d', roughness: 0.95 }), decal: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: dt, transparent: true, roughness: 0.8, polygonOffset: true, polygonOffsetFactor: -2 }), ground: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#0b0908', roughness: 1 }) }
  }, [])
  const wheel = (x: number) => (
    <group key={x} position={[x, -0.45, 0.1]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]}>
      <mesh material={o.tire}><torusGeometry args={[0.5, 0.075, 12, 40]} /></mesh>
      <mesh material={o.rust}><torusGeometry args={[0.43, 0.025, 8, 40]} /></mesh>
      <mesh rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} material={o.rust}><cylinderGeometry args={[0.1, 0.1, 0.16, 16]} /></mesh>
      {Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, k) => { const a = (k / 12) * Math.PI * 2; return <mesh key={k} position={[Math.sin(a) * 0.27, Math.cos(a) * 0.27, 0]} rotation={[0, 0, -a]} material={o.rust}><boxGeometry args={[0.035, 0.34, 0.045]} /></mesh> })}
    </group>
  )
  return (
    <group scale={0.75} position={[0, 0.3, 0]}>
      <group rotation={[0, -1.0, 0]} position={[0, 0, -0.9]}>
        <mesh position={[0, -0.22, 0]} material={o.dark}><boxGeometry args={[1.7, 0.1, 2.2]} /></mesh>
        <RoundedBox args={[1.5, 0.8, 2]} radius={0.06} smoothness={3} position={[0, 0.2, 0]} material={o.rust} />
        <object3D ref={(a) => { E.anchors[0] = a }} position={[0.76, 0.2, 0.1]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} />
        <mesh position={[0.755, 0.2, 0.1]} rotation={[0, Math.PI / 2, 0]} material={o.decal}><planeGeometry args={[1.1, 0.55]} /></mesh>

<file path="components/CustomCursor.tsx">
'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import gsap from 'gsap'

// Precision-UI cursor: hairline ring + dot. States: default, interactive (ring grows), room (ring grows + label).
export default function CustomCursor() {
  const dot = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), ring = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), label = useRef<HTMLSpanElement>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches || !dot.current || !ring.current || !label.current) return
    document.documentElement.classList.add('has-cursor')
    const dx = gsap.quickTo(dot.current, 'x', { duration: 0.08 }), dy = gsap.quickTo(dot.current, 'y', { duration: 0.08 })
    const rx = gsap.quickTo(ring.current, 'x', { duration: 0.7, ease: 'power3' }), ry = gsap.quickTo(ring.current, 'y', { duration: 0.7, ease: 'power3' })
    let mag: HTMLElement | null = null, state = ''
    const move = (e: PointerEvent) => {
      dx(e.clientX); dy(e.clientY); rx(e.clientX); ry(e.clientY)
      const el = e.target as HTMLElement
      const room = el.closest<HTMLElement>('[data-cursor]'), t = el.closest<HTMLElement>('a,button,[data-magnetic]')
      const next = t ? 'link' : room ? 'room' : ''
      if (next !== state) {
        state = next
        gsap.to(ring.current, { scale: next === 'room' ? 3.4 : next === 'link' ? 1.8 : 1, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power3.out' })
        gsap.to(label.current, { opacity: next === 'room' ? 1 : 0, duration: 0.6 }); if (room) label.current!.textContent = room.dataset.cursor ?? ''
        gsap.to(dot.current, { scale: next === 'room' ? 0 : 1, duration: 0.5 })
      }
      if (mag && mag !== t) gsap.to(mag, { x: 0, y: 0, duration: 1, ease: 'power3.out' })
      mag = t?.hasAttribute('data-magnetic') ? t : null
      if (mag) { const r = mag.getBoundingClientRect(); gsap.to(mag, { x: (e.clientX - (r.left + r.width / 2)) * 0.2, y: (e.clientY - (r.top + r.height / 2)) * 0.2, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power3.out' }) }
    }
    addEventListener('pointermove', move, { passive: true })
    return () => { removeEventListener('pointermove', move); document.documentElement.classList.remove('has-cursor') }
  }, [])
  return (<>
    <div ref={ring} className="pointer-events-none fixed left-0 top-0 z-[60] -ml-[11px] -mt-[11px] flex h-[22px] w-[22px] items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-bone/60 mix-blend-difference"><span ref={label} className="font-mono text-[3px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-bone opacity-0" /></div>
    <div ref={dot} className="pointer-events-none fixed left-0 top-0 z-[60] -ml-[1.5px] -mt-[1.5px] h-[3px] w-[3px] rounded-full bg-bone" />
  </>)
}

<file path="components/Dust.tsx">
'use client'
import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react'
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { P } from '../lib/progress'
import { warnW, warnArm, warnB } from '../lib/warn'
const RED = new THREE.Color('#ff4050'), BASE = new THREE.Color('#cbbfb5')

export default function Dust({ count = 320 }: { count?: number }) {
  const ref = useRef<THREE.Points>(null), mat = useRef<THREE.PointsMaterial>(null)
  const geo = useMemo(() => {
    const a = new Float32Array(count * 3)
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) { a[i * 3] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 14; a[i * 3 + 1] = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 8; a[i * 3 + 2] = 8 - Math.random() * 50 }
    const g = new THREE.BufferGeometry(); g.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(a, 3)); return g
  }, [count])
  useFrame(({ clock }) => { const w = warnW(), c = Math.min(1, warnArm(w) * warnB(w)); if (mat.current) { mat.current.opacity = 0.28 + 0.35 * c; mat.current.color.copy(BASE).lerp(RED, c) } if (ref.current && !P.reduced) { ref.current.rotation.y = clock.elapsedTime * 0.008; ref.current.position.y = Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 0.1) * 0.15 } })
  return <points ref={ref} geometry={geo}><pointsMaterial ref={mat} size={0.018} sizeAttenuation transparent opacity={0.28} color="#cbbfb5" depthWrite={false} /></points>
}

'use client'
import dynamic from 'next/dynamic'
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { ScrollTrigger } from 'gsap/ScrollTrigger'
import Lenis from 'lenis'
import { P, LENIS, LOAD } from '../lib/progress'
import { clamp, bell } from '../lib/math'
import Overlay from './Overlay'
import LabelLayer from './LabelLayer'
import CustomCursor from './CustomCursor'
import Booking from './Booking'
import TransitionFX from './TransitionFX'
import ThreatWarning from './ThreatWarning'
import LoadingSequence from './LoadingSequence'
import AudioDirector from './AudioDirector'
import SoundControl from './SoundControl'
import Observation from './Observation'
import { E, leaveRoom } from '../lib/enter'
const BrainScene = dynamic(() => import('./BrainScene'), { ssr: false })

export default function Experience() {
  const timeline = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
    const [started, setStarted] = useState(false), [booking, setBooking] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const onReady = useCallback(() => { LOAD.model = true }, []), onDone = useCallback(() => { P.introStart = performance.now(); setStarted(true); (LENIS.inst as { start?: () => void } | null)?.start?.() }, [])

  useEffect(() => {
    E.setBooking = setBooking
    const pop = () => { if (E.room >= 0) leaveRoom() }, esc = (e: KeyboardEvent) => { if (e.key === 'Escape' && E.room >= 0 && !E.busy) history.state?.room !== undefined ? history.back() : leaveRoom() }
    addEventListener('popstate', pop); addEventListener('keydown', esc)
    return () => { removeEventListener('popstate', pop); removeEventListener('keydown', esc) }
  }, [])
  useEffect(() => {
    gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger)
    const reduced = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
    P.reduced = reduced
    const lenis = new Lenis({ lerp: reduced ? 1 : 0.08 })
    LENIS.inst = lenis; lenis.stop() // scroll stays locked until the initialization sequence completes
    lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update)
    const tick = (_t: number, dtMs: number) => {
      lenis.raf(performance.now())
      const k = reduced ? 1 : 1 - Math.exp(-(dtMs / 1000) * 6)
      P.value += (P.target - P.value) * k; P.r += (P.rTarget - P.r) * k
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--tension', String(bell(0.3, 0.5, 0.85, P.value)))
    }
    gsap.ticker.add(tick); gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0)
    const ctx = gsap.context(() => {
      ScrollTrigger.create({ trigger: timeline.current, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom bottom', onUpdate: (s) => { P.target = clamp(s.progress / 0.62); P.rTarget = clamp((s.progress - 0.6) / 0.37) } })
    })
    const move = (e: PointerEvent) => { P.mx = (e.clientX / innerWidth) * 2 - 1; P.my = (e.clientY / innerHeight) * 2 - 1 }
    addEventListener('pointermove', move, { passive: true })
    return () => { removeEventListener('pointermove', move); gsap.ticker.remove(tick); ctx.revert(); lenis.destroy(); P.target = P.value = P.rTarget = P.r = 0 }
  }, [])

  return (
    <main>
      <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[2] " aria-label="Interactive 3D human brain">
        <BrainScene onReady={onReady} />
      </div>
      <LabelLayer /><ThreatWarning /><div className="vignette" /><div className="grain" />
      <Overlay ready={started} />
      <div ref={timeline} className="relative z-10 h-[1000vh]" aria-hidden />
      <div id="room-ui" className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-40" />
      <TransitionFX />
      <Observation /><AudioDirector /><SoundControl /><LoadingSequence onDone={onDone} />
      {booking !== null && <Booking room={booking} onLeave={() => (history.state?.room !== undefined ? history.back() : leaveRoom())} />}
      <CustomCursor />
    </main>
  )
}

<file path="components/LabelDriver.tsx">
'use client'
import { useMemo } from 'react'
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { P, S } from '../lib/progress'
import { sstep, clamp, bell } from '../lib/math'
import { LABELS } from '../lib/labels'
import type { Piece } from '../lib/pieces'

// Projects the real mesh centres to screen space each frame and moves the DOM labels (no React state).
export default function LabelDriver() {
  const v = useMemo(() => new THREE.Vector3(), []), w = useMemo(() => new THREE.Vector3(), [])
  const c = useMemo(() => ({ els: [] as (HTMLElement | null)[], cands: [] as Piece[][], pick: [] as number[], pos: [] as { x: number; y: number }[] }), [])
  useFrame(({ camera, size, clock }) => {
    if (!S.pieces.length) return
    const p = P.value
    LABELS.forEach((L, i) => {
      const el = (c.els[i] ??= document.getElementById('lbl-' + i)); if (!el) return
      const win = sstep(L.from, L.from + 0.04, p) * (1 - sstep(L.to - 0.04, L.to, p))
      if (win < 0.003) { if (el.style.opacity !== '0') el.style.opacity = '0'; return }
      const cands = (c.cands[i] ??= S.pieces.filter((pc) => L.re.test((pc.mesh.userData.name ?? pc.mesh.name) as string))); if (!cands.length) return
      let best = -9, bi = 0
      cands.forEach((pc, j) => { pc.mesh.getWorldPosition(v); w.copy(camera.position).sub(v).normalize(); const f = v.normalize().dot(w); if (f > best) { best = f; bi = j } })
      const pc = cands[bi]
      if (L.derive !== undefined) { v.set(0, 0, pc.mesh.geometry.boundingBox!.max.z + L.derive); pc.mesh.localToWorld(v) } else pc.mesh.getWorldPosition(v)
      let a = win * (1 - sstep(0, 0.35, clamp((p - pc.start) / pc.dur)))
      if (L.facing) a *= sstep(0.1, 0.4, best)
      v.project(camera)
      if (v.z > 1 || a < 0.003) { el.style.opacity = '0'; return }
      const tx = (v.x * 0.5 + 0.5) * size.width, ty = (-v.y * 0.5 + 0.5) * size.height, q = (c.pos[i] ??= { x: tx, y: ty }), k = 0.35 - 0.28 * bell(0.3, 0.4, 0.5, p) // labels lag behind as the anatomy destabilises
      q.x += (tx - q.x) * k; q.y += (ty - q.y) * k
      const ins = P.reduced ? 0 : bell(0.28, 0.36, 0.46, p), t = clock.elapsedTime // the tracking system destabilises as the anatomy separates
      el.style.transform = `translate3d(${q.x + Math.sin(t * 9 + i * 3) * 9 * ins}px,${q.y + Math.cos(t * 7 + i * 2) * 7 * ins}px,0)`
      const fl = P.reduced ? 0 : 0.07 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 13 + i * 5)) * (Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 0.7 + i) > 0.92 ? 1 : 0) // rare tiny data flicker
      el.style.setProperty('--d', String(sstep(0, 0.8, win) * (1 - 0.4 * ins * (0.5 + 0.5 * Math.sin(t * 3 + i))))); el.style.opacity = String(a * (1 - fl))
      const stEl = el.querySelector('[data-status]'); if (stEl) { const tx = p > 0.33 ? L.lost : `Status: active · ${L.tag}`; if (stEl.textContent !== tx) stEl.textContent = tx }
      if (c.pick[i] !== bi) { c.pick[i] = bi; const m = el.querySelector('[data-meta]'); if (m) m.textContent = `${L.approx ? '≈ ' : ''}A-0${i + 1} · XYZ ${(pc.home.x * 1000).toFixed(0)} ${(pc.home.y * 1000).toFixed(0)} ${(pc.home.z * 1000).toFixed(0)}` }
    })
  })
  return null
}

'use client'
import { useRef } from 'react'
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { Environment, Lightformer } from '@react-three/drei'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { P, introT } from '../lib/progress'
import { sstep, bell } from '../lib/math'

// Black void, film lighting: soft key, cool fill, hard cool rim, a very low red practical deep behind the brain.
export default function Lights() {
  const key = useRef<THREE.DirectionalLight>(null), rimA = useRef<THREE.PointLight>(null), rimB = useRef<THREE.PointLight>(null), prac = useRef<THREE.PointLight>(null), inner = useRef<THREE.PointLight>(null)
  useFrame(({ camera, clock, scene, gl }) => {
    const p = P.value, t = clock.elapsedTime, inside = bell(0.66, 0.8, 0.93, p), red = P.reduced
    const em = P.reduced ? 1 : sstep(1.6, 5.5, introT()), dark = 1 - 0.28 * bell(0.3, 0.45, 0.62, p)
    const flick = red ? 0 : bell(0.3, 0.42, 0.62, p) * Math.sin(t * 47) * Math.sin(t * 13.3)
    const breathe = red ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.5
    if (key.current) key.current.intensity = em * dark * (1.05 * (1 - 0.8 * sstep(0.6, 0.8, p)) + 0.1) * (1 + 0.12 * flick)
    if (rimA.current) rimA.current.intensity = em * 26 * (1 + 0.4 * sstep(0.15, 0.5, p)) * (1 + 0.05 * breathe)
    if (rimB.current) rimB.current.intensity = em * 12 * (0.7 + 0.6 * sstep(0.3, 0.6, p))
    if (prac.current) prac.current.intensity = em * (3 + breathe * 0.8 + flick * 0.6) * (1 + 1.2 * bell(0.3, 0.5, 0.8, p) + sstep(0.4, 0.7, p))
    if (inner.current) { inner.current.position.copy(camera.position); inner.current.intensity = 1.6 * inside }
    scene.environmentIntensity = em * 0.3 * (1 - 0.75 * inside)
    gl.toneMappingExposure = 1.1 - 0.3 * inside
  })
  return (
    <>
      <hemisphereLight args={['#8fa0b8', '#0a0505', 0.2]} />
      <directionalLight ref={key} position={[2.5, 3.5, 5]} color="#f1e4dc" />
      <pointLight ref={rimA} position={[-4, 2.2, -3.5]} color="#d6e0f5" distance={16} decay={2} />
      <pointLight ref={rimB} position={[4, 0.5, -3.5]} color="#cfd6e6" distance={16} decay={2} />
      <pointLight ref={prac} position={[0, 0.2, -1.4]} color="#7a1018" distance={6} decay={2} />
      <pointLight ref={inner} color="#8a3a30" distance={4} decay={2} intensity={0} />
      <Environment resolution={64}>
        <Lightformer form="rect" intensity={1.2} position={[0, 4, 3]} scale={[8, 2, 1]} />
        <Lightformer form="rect" intensity={1} position={[-5, 0, -2]} scale={[1, 6, 1]} color="#cfd8ff" />
      </Environment>
    </>
  )
}

<file path="components/LoadingSequence.tsx">
'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useProgress } from '@react-three/drei'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { LOAD, S, SPEC } from '../lib/progress'
import { AUDIO } from '../lib/audio'

// Initialization, tied to real milestones: WebGL context up, GLB + Draco decoded, specimen pieces built, specimen environment built. Lines resolve one after another
// (min 0.3 s each, so a fast load ends fast). While anatomical data is genuinely loading, its line shows the real progress instead of OK.
const LINES = [{ t: 'Initializing optics', ok: 'OK', f: () => LOAD.canvas }, { t: 'Anatomical data', ok: 'OK', f: () => LOAD.model, prog: true }, { t: 'Specimen', ok: 'FOUND', f: () => LOAD.model && S.pieces.length > 0 }, { t: 'Environment', ok: 'READY', f: () => SPEC.v > 0 }]
export default function LoadingSequence({ onDone }: { onDone: () => void }) {
  const { progress } = useProgress(), pr = useRef(0), root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), rows = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([]), val = useRef<(HTMLSpanElement | null)[]>([]), mark = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null)
  const [gone, setGone] = useState(false)
  pr.current = progress
  useEffect(() => {
    const st = { rev: [] as number[], done: [] as number[], fin: 0, modelT: 0, over: false }, t0 = performance.now() / 1000
    const fn = () => {
      const t = performance.now() / 1000; if (st.over) return
      if (LOAD.model && !st.modelT) st.modelT = t
      LINES.forEach((l, i) => {
        const el = rows.current[i], v = val.current[i]; if (!el || !v) return
        if (st.rev[i] === undefined && (i === 0 ? t - t0 > 0.35 : st.done[i - 1] !== undefined && t - st.done[i - 1] > 0.15)) { st.rev[i] = t; AUDIO.relay() }
        if (st.rev[i] === undefined) return; el.style.opacity = '1'
        const timeout = i === 3 && st.modelT && t - st.modelT > 8
        if (st.done[i] === undefined && (l.f() || timeout) && t - st.rev[i] > 0.3) { st.done[i] = t; AUDIO.relay() }
        v.textContent = st.done[i] !== undefined ? l.ok : l.prog && pr.current > 0 && pr.current < 100 ? `${Math.round(pr.current)}%` : '…'
      })
      if (st.done.length === LINES.length && st.done.every((d) => d !== undefined) && !st.fin) {
        st.fin = t; if (mark.current) { mark.current.style.opacity = '1'; mark.current.style.letterSpacing = '0.7em' }
        gsap.delayedCall(0.8, () => { st.over = true; onDone(); gsap.to(root.current, { opacity: 0, duration: 1.2, ease: 'power2.inOut', onComplete: () => setGone(true) }) })
      }
    }
    gsap.ticker.add(fn); return () => gsap.ticker.remove(fn)
  }, [onDone])
  if (gone) return null
  return (
    <div ref={root} className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] grid place-items-center bg-black font-mono">
      <div className="w-[min(24rem,84vw)] text-[10px] uppercase leading-[2.4] tracking-[0.3em] text-bone/60">
        <p ref={mark} className="mb-8 font-display text-[22px] font-medium normal-case tracking-[0.5em] text-bone/70 transition-all duration-[900ms]" style={{ opacity: 0.55 }}>AMYGDREAD</p>
        {LINES.map((l, i) => (<div key={l.t} ref={(e) => { rows.current[i] = e }} className="flex items-baseline gap-3 opacity-0 transition-opacity duration-500"><span>{l.t}</span><i className="mb-[3px] flex-1 border-b border-dotted border-bone/20" /><span ref={(e) => { val.current[i] = e }} className="text-bone" /></div>))}
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

<file path="components/Observation.tsx">
'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { P, H } from '../lib/progress'
import { E } from '../lib/enter'
import { AUDIO } from '../lib/audio'
import { LABELS } from '../lib/labels'

// "The system is observing you." States: OBSERVATION_INACTIVE · OBSERVATION_ACTIVE · ROOM_HOVER · ROOM_SELECTED. It only ever acts in the brain phase; it reacts rarely,
// after a variable delay, and only when the cursor lingers over the specimen. A tiny marker drifts toward the cursor, locks on, a hairline connects it to the nearest
// anatomical marker, a short indicator appears, then it lets go. Room reactions live in RoomWorlds / Tombstone / audio (hover).
type Obs = 'OBSERVATION_INACTIVE' | 'OBSERVATION_ACTIVE' | 'ROOM_HOVER' | 'ROOM_SELECTED'
export default function Observation() {
  const mark = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), tag = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null), ln = useRef<SVGLineElement>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    const m = { x: innerWidth / 2, y: innerHeight / 2 }, s = { dwell: 0, active: false, t0: 0, until: 0, cool: 0, delay: -1, lx: 0, ly: 0, op: 0 }
    const mv = (e: PointerEvent) => { m.x = e.clientX; m.y = e.clientY }; addEventListener('pointermove', mv, { passive: true })
    let last = performance.now()
    const fn = () => {
      const now = performance.now(), dt = Math.min(0.1, (now - last) / 1000), t = now / 1000; last = now
      const state: Obs = E.room >= 0 ? 'ROOM_SELECTED' : H.i >= 0 ? 'ROOM_HOVER' : s.active ? 'OBSERVATION_ACTIVE' : 'OBSERVATION_INACTIVE'
      const allowed = state !== 'ROOM_SELECTED' && state !== 'ROOM_HOVER' && !E.booked && P.value > 0.03 && P.value < 0.4 && P.r < 0.001
      const inside = Math.hypot(m.x - innerWidth / 2, m.y - innerHeight * 0.45) < innerHeight * 0.3
      if (allowed && inside) {
        s.dwell += dt
        if (!s.active && t > s.cool && s.dwell > 1.8) { if (s.delay < 0) s.delay = t + 0.2 + Math.random() * 1.4; if (t > s.delay) { s.active = true; s.t0 = t; s.until = t + 2.4 + Math.random() * 1.2; s.cool = t + 14 + Math.random() * 8; s.lx = m.x + 60; s.ly = m.y + 40; if (tag.current) tag.current.textContent = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 'Observation active' : 'Tracking active'; AUDIO.blip() } }
      } else { s.dwell = 0; s.delay = -1; if (s.active) s.until = Math.min(s.until, t + 0.15) }
      if (s.active && t > s.until) s.active = false
      s.op += ((s.active ? 1 : 0) - s.op) * Math.min(1, dt * (s.active ? 3 : 6))
      if (s.op < 0.01) { if (mark.current && mark.current.style.opacity !== '0') { mark.current.style.opacity = '0'; if (tag.current) tag.current.style.opacity = '0'; if (ln.current) ln.current.style.opacity = '0' } return }
      const k = 0.8 + 2.5 * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - s.t0) / 1.2)); s.lx += (m.x - s.lx) * Math.min(1, dt * k); s.ly += (m.y - s.ly) * Math.min(1, dt * k)
      if (mark.current) { mark.current.style.opacity = String(0.8 * s.op); mark.current.style.transform = `translate(${s.lx - 6}px,${s.ly - 6}px)` }
      if (tag.current) { tag.current.style.opacity = String(0.7 * s.op); tag.current.style.transform = `translate(${s.lx + 12}px,${s.ly - 4}px)` }
      let best: DOMRect | null = null, bd = 1e9
      for (let i = 0; i < LABELS.length; i++) { const el = document.getElementById('lbl-' + i); if (!el || parseFloat(el.style.opacity || '0') < 0.2) continue; const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(), d = Math.hypot(r.left - s.lx, r.top - s.ly); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = r } }
      if (ln.current) { if (best) { ln.current.setAttribute('x1', String(best.left)); ln.current.setAttribute('y1', String(best.top)); ln.current.setAttribute('x2', String(s.lx)); ln.current.setAttribute('y2', String(s.ly)); ln.current.style.opacity = String(0.25 * s.op) } else ln.current.style.opacity = '0' }
    }
    gsap.ticker.add(fn); return () => { gsap.ticker.remove(fn); removeEventListener('pointermove', mv) }
  }, [])
  return (
    <div className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-[27]" aria-hidden>
      <svg className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full" stroke="#e9e4dc" strokeWidth="1"><line ref={ln} style={{ opacity: 0 }} /></svg>
      <div ref={mark} className="absolute left-0 top-0 h-3 w-3 border border-bone/70 opacity-0"><i className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 h-[3px] w-[3px] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-full bg-bone" /></div>
      <p ref={tag} className="absolute left-0 top-0 whitespace-nowrap font-mono text-[8px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-bone opacity-0" />
    </div>
  )
}
</file>

<file path="components/Overlay.tsx">
'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { P, LENIS } from '../lib/progress'
import { clamp, sstep } from '../lib/math'
import { overlay } from '../lib/content'

const SIZE = { xl: 'text-[clamp(3.6rem,14vw,15rem)] leading-[0.86]', lg: 'text-[clamp(2.6rem,8vw,8rem)] leading-[0.92]', md: 'text-[clamp(1.6rem,3.6vw,3.6rem)] leading-[1.05]', sm: 'text-[clamp(1.1rem,1.7vw,1.7rem)] leading-[1.15]', xs: 'font-mono !not-italic !font-normal !tracking-[0.4em] text-[10px] uppercase leading-[2.2]' }
const ease = (x: number) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - x, 3)

const go = (f: number) => LENIS.inst?.scrollTo(f * (document.documentElement.scrollHeight - innerHeight))
export default function Overlay({ ready }: { ready: boolean }) {
  const credit = useRef<HTMLParagraphElement>(null)
  const refs = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([])
  const head = useRef<HTMLElement>(null), nav = useRef<HTMLElement>(null), bar = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    const els = refs.current.map((el) => (el ? Array.from(el.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.inner')) : []))
    const fn = () => {
      const p = P.value
      overlay.forEach((it, i) => {
        const el = refs.current[i]; if (!el) return
        const q = it.r ? P.r : p
        const fin = it.from === 0 ? 1 : sstep(it.from, it.from + 0.035, q), fout = 1 - sstep(it.to - 0.035, it.to, q)
        const o = Math.min(fin, fout)
        el.style.opacity = String(o); el.style.visibility = o < 0.01 ? 'hidden' : 'visible'
        if (o < 0.01) return
        const n = els[i].length
        els[i].forEach((inner, j) => {
          const local = clamp(fin * (1 + 0.4 * (n - 1)) - j * 0.4)
          const y = fout < 1 ? -105 * (1 - fout) : 105 * (1 - ease(local))
          inner.style.transform = `translate3d(0,${y}%,0)`
        })
      })
      if (head.current) head.current.style.opacity = String(sstep(0.08, 0.16, p))
      if (nav.current) nav.current.style.opacity = String(sstep(0.9, 0.97, p))
      if (credit.current) credit.current.style.opacity = String(sstep(0.9, 1, P.r))
      if (bar.current) bar.current.style.transform = `scaleY(${p})`
    }
    gsap.ticker.add(fn); return () => gsap.ticker.remove(fn)
  }, [])
  return (
    <div className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-30 transition-opacity duration-[2000ms] delay-[1200ms]" style={{ opacity: ready ? 1 : 0 }}>
      <header ref={head} style={{ opacity: 0 }} className="absolute left-0 right-0 top-0 flex items-start justify-between px-[3.5vw] pt-6 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.5em] text-bone/80">
        <a href="#top" className="pointer-events-auto" data-magnetic>Amygdread</a>
        <nav ref={nav} className="pointer-events-auto flex gap-8 opacity-0"><button data-magnetic onClick={() => go(1)}>Rooms</button></nav>
      </header>
      {overlay.map((it, i) => (
        <div key={i} ref={(el) => { refs.current[i] = el }} className={`absolute ${it.pos} ${it.align ?? ''}`} style={{ opacity: 0, visibility: 'hidden' }}>
          {it.kicker && <p className="mb-5 font-mono text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.4em] text-bone/50">{it.kicker}</p>}
          {it.lines.map((l, j) => (
            <span key={j} className="block overflow-hidden py-[0.05em] -my-[0.05em]">
              <span className={`inner block font-display font-light italic tracking-[-0.03em] will-change-transform ${SIZE[it.size]} ${it.redFrom !== undefined && j >= it.redFrom ? 'text-blood' : 'text-bone'}`}>{l}</span>
            </span>
          ))}
        </div>
      ))}
      <p ref={credit} style={{ opacity: 0 }} className="absolute bottom-3 left-[3.5vw] max-w-[60ch] font-mono text-[8px] uppercase leading-relaxed tracking-[0.2em] text-bone/30">© Amygdread · Brain model brain.glb, github.com/itayinbarr/brainproject, CC BY-SA 4.0, modified</p>
      <div className="absolute bottom-0 right-[2vw] top-0 hidden w-px bg-bone/10 md:block"><div ref={bar} className="h-full origin-top bg-blood" style={{ transform: 'scaleY(0)' }} /></div>
    </div>
  )
}
</file>

// One lonely grave in an enormous dark: sparse dead grass, distant bare trees, low cold ground fog.
export function TombEnv() {
  const fog = useRef<THREE.Mesh[]>([])
  const o = useMemo(() => {
    const blade = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(0.025, 0.4, 1, 3); blade.translate(0, 0.2, 0)
    const grass = new THREE.InstancedMesh(blade, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#3a3320', roughness: 1, side: THREE.DoubleSide }), 420), d = new THREE.Object3D()
    for (let i = 0; i < 420; i++) { const an = rnd(i, 1) * 6.28, r = 0.9 + rnd(i, 2) * 2.5, x = Math.cos(an) * r * 0.9, z = Math.sin(an) * r * 2 + 0.3; d.position.set(x, -0.95 + 0.32 * Math.exp(-(x * x + (z / 2.3) * (z / 2.3)) / 1.8), z); d.rotation.set((rnd(i, 3) - 0.5) * 0.7, rnd(i, 4) * 6.28, (rnd(i, 5) - 0.5) * 0.7); d.scale.set(1, 0.5 + rnd(i, 6) * 0.9, 1); d.updateMatrix(); grass.setMatrixAt(i, d.matrix) }
    const tm = dark('#050605', 0, 1), trees = [[-5, -7], [-3.4, -9], [-1.2, -8], [2.4, -9.5], [4.2, -7.5], [5.6, -10]].map(([x, z], i) => ({ x, z, h: 6 + rnd(i, 9) * 2, br: [0, 1, 2].map((k) => V([[x, 3 + k * 0.6, z], [x + (rnd(i * 3 + k, 7) - 0.5) * 1.4, 4 + k * 0.7, z + 0.1], [x + (rnd(i * 3 + k, 8) - 0.5) * 2.4, 5.2 + k * 0.6, z]])) }))
    const rt = dark('#1b120a', 0, 1), under = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => V([[(rnd(i, 31) - 0.5) * 1.8, -0.85, 1.1 + rnd(i, 32) * 0.9], [(rnd(i, 33) - 0.5) * 1.6, -2, 1.1 + rnd(i, 34) * 0.9], [(rnd(i, 35) - 0.5) * 1.8, -3.4, 1 + rnd(i, 36)], [(rnd(i, 37) - 0.5) * 1.6, -5.2, 1.1 + rnd(i, 38) * 0.9]]))
    const pg = new THREE.BufferGeometry(), pa = new Float32Array(260 * 3); for (let i = 0; i < 260; i++) { pa[i * 3] = (rnd(i, 41) - 0.5) * 3; pa[i * 3 + 1] = -1 - rnd(i, 42) * 5; pa[i * 3 + 2] = 0.7 + rnd(i, 43) * 1.8 } pg.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(pa, 3))
    const st = bake(512, 512, (u, v) => { const band = Math.floor((1 - v) * 8 + fbm(u * 3, v * 3, 9) * 2), cols = [[0.05, 0.035, 0.025], [0.1, 0.07, 0.045], [0.07, 0.06, 0.05], [0.13, 0.09, 0.06], [0.06, 0.05, 0.04], [0.1, 0.08, 0.06], [0.05, 0.04, 0.035], [0.08, 0.06, 0.05]], c = cols[band % 8], n = 0.7 + 0.6 * fbm(u * 30, v * 30, 5), stn = sm(0.74, 0.8, fbm(u * 14, v * 14, 6)); return [c[0] * n + 0.06 * stn, c[1] * n + 0.06 * stn, c[2] * n + 0.055 * stn, 1, 0, 0.5 + (n - 1) * 0.5] })
    const ac = document.createElement('canvas'); ac.width = 8; ac.height = 256; const ax = ac.getContext('2d')!; const ag = ax.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 256); ag.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); ag.addColorStop(0.35, '#bbb'); ag.addColorStop(1, '#000'); ax.fillStyle = ag; ax.fillRect(0, 0, 8, 256)
    const wall = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(3.2, 2.9, 4.6, 64, 14, true), wp = wall.attributes.position; for (let i = 0; i < wp.count; i++) { const x = wp.getX(i), z = wp.getZ(i), y = wp.getY(i), f = 1 + 0.06 * (fbm(Math.atan2(z, x) * 3, y * 0.8, 2) - 0.5); wp.setX(i, x * f); wp.setZ(i, z * f) } wall.computeVertexNormals()
    const wm = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: st.map, roughnessMap: st.orm, roughness: 1, bumpMap: st.bump, bumpScale: 3, alphaMap: new THREE.CanvasTexture(ac), transparent: true })
    const R = (y: number) => 3.2 - 0.3 * ((-0.85 - y) / 4.6), onWall = (phi: number, y: number, k = 1) => new THREE.Vector3(R(y) * k * Math.sin(phi) * 0.9, y, 0.3 + R(y) * k * Math.cos(phi) * 2.3)
    const wroots = Array.from({ length: 8 }, (_, i) => { const phi = -1.1 + i * 0.3 + (rnd(i, 51) - 0.5) * 0.1; return V([-1.1, -2, -3, -4].map((y, j) => { const p = onWall(phi + (rnd(i * 4 + j, 52) - 0.5) * 0.12, y - (rnd(i, 53)) * 0.3, 1.02); return [p.x, p.y, p.z] })) })
    const stones = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => { const p = onWall(-1.2 + i * 0.4 + rnd(i, 61) * 0.15, -1.4 - rnd(i, 62) * 2.8, 0.985); return { p, s: 0.15 + rnd(i, 63) * 0.15 } })
    const planks = [[-0.4, -2.6], [0.6, -3.5]].map(([phi, y], i) => ({ p: onWall(phi, y, 1.0), r: -phi, t: i }))
    return { grass, tm, trees, tex: soft(), rt, under, pg, wall, wm, wroots, stones, planks, stone: dark('#2a2a28', 0, 1), wood: dark('#1c140d', 0, 1) }
  }, [])
  useFrame(({ clock }) => { const t = clock.elapsedTime; o.grass.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 0.4) * 0.002 * (1 + 5 * (H.i === 1 ? 1 : 0)); o.grass.rotation.x = Math.cos(t * 0.33) * 0.0015 * (1 + 5 * (H.i === 1 ? 1 : 0)); fog.current.forEach((m, k) => { if (m) { m.position.x = Math.sin(t * 0.05 + k * 2) * 0.8; m.rotation.z = t * 0.01 * (k + 1) } }) })
  return (
    <group>
      <mesh geometry={o.wall} material={o.wm} position={[0, -3.15, 0.3]} scale={[0.9, 1, 2.3]} />
      {o.wroots.map((c, i) => <mesh key={`w${i}`} material={o.rt}><tubeGeometry args={[c, 20, 0.05 + (i % 3) * 0.015, 6, false]} /></mesh>)}
      {o.stones.map((q, i) => <mesh key={`s${i}`} position={q.p} scale={[q.s, q.s * 0.7, q.s * 0.8]} rotation={[i, i * 2, 0]} material={o.stone}><icosahedronGeometry args={[1, 1]} /></mesh>)}
      {o.planks.map((q, i) => <mesh key={`k${i}`} position={q.p} rotation={[0.1 * i, q.r, 0.2 - 0.3 * i]} material={o.wood}><boxGeometry args={[0.6, 0.06, 0.16]} /></mesh>)}
      <primitive object={o.grass} />
      {o.under.map((c, i) => <mesh key={i} material={o.rt}><tubeGeometry args={[c, 28, 0.03 + (i % 3) * 0.015, 6, false]} /></mesh>)}
      <points geometry={o.pg}><pointsMaterial size={0.03} color="#3a2a1c" sizeAttenuation transparent opacity={0.8} depthWrite={false} /></points>
      {o.trees.map((t, i) => <group key={i}><mesh position={[t.x, t.h / 2 - 1, t.z]} material={o.tm}><cylinderGeometry args={[0.1, 0.22, t.h, 7]} /></mesh>{t.br.map((c, k) => <mesh key={k} material={o.tm}><tubeGeometry args={[c, 12, 0.05, 5, false]} /></mesh>)}</group>)}
      {[0, 1, 2].map((k) => <mesh key={k} ref={(m) => { if (m) fog.current[k] = m }} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -0.78 + k * 0.12, 0.3 - k]}><planeGeometry args={[7, 7]} /><meshBasicMaterial map={o.tex} color="#4a4636" opacity={0.13} transparent blending={THREE.AdditiveBlending} depthWrite={false} /></mesh>)}
    </group>
  )

'use client'
import { useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react'
import { useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { Html, useGLTF } from '@react-three/drei'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { P, H } from '../lib/progress'
import { sstep } from '../lib/math'
import { rooms } from '../lib/content'
import { E, enterRoom } from '../lib/enter'
import Canteen from './Canteen'
import Tombstone from './Tombstone'
import { CanteenEnv, TombEnv } from './RoomEnv'

// Two different realities. Lights are the only thing that exists at first: the artifacts are ghosts until they resolve.
const CFG = [
  { beacon: '#c4642a', glow: '#6a2410', lights: [{ c: '#ff8a4a', p: [1.6, 1.2, 2.2], i: 70 }, { c: '#ff3a2a', p: [-1, 0.5, -2.2], i: 40 }, { c: '#7a6a58', p: [-2.5, 1, 2], i: 8 }, { c: '#ffb070', p: [0, 3.1, -0.4], i: 22 }, { c: '#ff7a3a', p: [0, -1.6, 0.3], i: 14 }, { c: '#ff8a4a', p: [0, -0.2, 3.5], i: 12 }] },
  { beacon: '#6a6a50', glow: '#2a1a14', lights: [{ c: '#8a6a44', p: [-2.2, 1.6, 1.8], i: 38 }, { c: '#5a1a1a', p: [1, 0.4, -2.2], i: 38 }, { c: '#4a5a2a', p: [0, -0.8, 2], i: 8 }, { c: '#3a1c14', p: [0, -1.4, 2.4], i: 10 }, { c: '#6a3a2a', p: [0, -0.4, 3.5], i: 10 }] },
]
function glowTexture() {
  const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 256; const x = c.getContext('2d')!
  const g = x.createRadialGradient(128, 128, 0, 128, 128, 128); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)'); g.addColorStop(0.4, 'rgba(255,255,255,.3)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)')
  x.fillStyle = g; x.fillRect(0, 0, 256, 256); return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c)
}
// Drop a real, openly licensed GLB into public/models and set rooms[i].model: it replaces the procedural artifact.
function ModelSlot({ url }: { url: string }) {
  const { scene } = useGLTF(url), box = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(scene), sz = box.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()), c = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3()), k = 3 / Math.max(sz.x, sz.y, sz.z)
  return <group scale={k} position={[-c.x * k, -c.y * k, -c.z * k]}><primitive object={scene} /></group>
}
function Room({ i }: { i: number }) {
  const room = rooms[i], cfg = CFG[i]
  const beacon = useRef<THREE.Mesh>(null), g = useRef<THREE.Group>(null), art = useRef<THREE.Group>(null), L = useRef<THREE.PointLight[]>([]), txt = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const mats = useRef<THREE.Material[]>([]), st = useRef({ h: 0, q: 0 }), [on, setOn] = useState(false)
  const { size } = useThree(), portrait = size.width / size.height < 1
  const s = portrait ? 0.55 : 1, px = portrait ? 0 : i ? 3.6 : -3.6, py = portrait ? (i ? -1.75 : 1.55) : 0.4
  const tex = useMemo(glowTexture, []), portal = useMemo(() => ({ current: document.getElementById('room-ui') as HTMLElement }), [])
  useFrame(({ clock }) => {
    if (!on && (P.value > 0.62 || P.r > 0)) setOn(true)
    const gr = g.current; if (!gr) return
    const r = P.r, rev = sstep(i ? 0.4 : 0.34, i ? 0.86 : 0.78, r), t = clock.elapsedTime, a = st.current, red = P.reduced
    a.h += ((H.i === i ? 1 : 0) - a.h) * 0.04; a.q += ((H.i >= 0 && H.i !== i ? 1 : 0) - a.q) * 0.04
    const bm = beacon.current; if (bm) { const bc = sstep(0.25, 0.35, r) * (1 - 0.6 * sstep(0.5, 0.75, r)); (bm.material as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial).opacity = 0.5 * bc * (1 - 0.9 * E.quiet); bm.visible = bc > 0.003; bm.scale.setScalar(3 + 0.3 * Math.sin(t * 0.7 + i)) } // a faint warm / cold glow far off, before the scan has finished
    gr.visible = on && rev > 0.003; if (!gr.visible) return
    if (!mats.current.length && gr.children.length > 3) gr.traverse((o: any) => { if (o.isMesh) (Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material : [o.material]).forEach((m: THREE.Material) => { if (!mats.current.includes(m)) { m.userData.b = m.opacity; m.transparent = true; m.needsUpdate = true; mats.current.push(m) } }) })
    const op = Math.pow(rev, 1.4) * (1 - 0.45 * a.q) * (1 - 0.9 * E.quiet * (E.room === i ? 0 : 1))
    mats.current.forEach((m) => { m.opacity = m.userData.b * op })
    cfg.lights.forEach((l, j) => { const pl = L.current[j]; if (pl) pl.intensity = l.i * Math.pow(rev, 1.2) * (1 + 0.9 * a.h * (j === 0 ? 1 : i === 1 && j === 1 ? 1.2 : 0.3)) * (1 - 0.5 * a.q) * (1 + (red ? 0 : 0.05 * Math.sin(t * 0.8 + i))) * (1 - 0.9 * E.quiet * (E.room === i ? 0 : 1)) * (i === 0 ? 1 + 0.8 * Math.max(0, E.k) : 1 - 0.95 * E.dark) * (i === 0 && j === 3 ? 1 + 0.15 * a.h * Math.sin(t * 19 + Math.sin(t * 3) * 4) : 1) })
    gr.position.set(px, py, -30 + a.h - a.q * 0.8)
    if (art.current) { art.current.rotation.y = (red ? 0 : P.mx * 0.18 * (1 + a.h)); art.current.rotation.x = red ? 0 : P.my * 0.05; art.current.position.y = red ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.4 + i) * 0.02 }
    if (txt.current) { txt.current.style.opacity = String(sstep(0.85, 0.97, r) * (0.5 + 0.5 * a.h) * (1 - 0.4 * a.q) * (1 - E.quiet)); txt.current.style.transform = `translateY(${(1 - a.h) * 4}px)` }
  })
  return (
    <>
    <mesh ref={beacon} position={[px, py + 0.2, -31]} visible={false}><planeGeometry args={[1, 1]} /><meshBasicMaterial map={tex} color={cfg.beacon} transparent opacity={0} blending={THREE.AdditiveBlending} depthWrite={false} /></mesh>
    <group ref={g} position={[px, py, -30]} scale={s} visible={false}>
      <mesh position={[0, 0.2, -1.8]}><planeGeometry args={[7, 6]} /><meshBasicMaterial map={tex} color={cfg.glow} opacity={0.35} transparent blending={THREE.AdditiveBlending} depthWrite={false} /></mesh>
      {on && <group ref={art}>{room.model ? <ModelSlot url={room.model} /> : i === 0 ? <Canteen /> : <Tombstone />}</group>}
      {on && (i === 0 ? <CanteenEnv /> : <TombEnv />)}
      {cfg.lights.map((l, j) => <pointLight key={j} ref={(p) => { if (p) L.current[j] = p }} position={l.p as [number, number, number]} color={l.c} distance={12} decay={2} intensity={0} />)}
      <mesh position={[0, 0.2, 0]} onPointerOver={() => { if (P.r > 0.9 && E.room < 0) H.i = i }} onPointerOut={() => { if (H.i === i) H.i = -1 }} onClick={() => { if (P.r > 0.9) enterRoom(i) }}><planeGeometry args={[5, 6]} /><meshBasicMaterial transparent opacity={0} depthWrite={false} /></mesh>
      <Html position={[0, -2.35, 0]} center portal={portal as any} pointerEvents="none" zIndexRange={[40, 0]}>
        <div ref={txt} style={{ opacity: 0 }} className="w-[min(80vw,24rem)] text-center transition-transform duration-[1800ms]">
          <p className="font-mono text-[10px] tracking-[0.5em] text-bone/60">{room.n}</p>
          <h3 className="mt-2 font-display text-[clamp(2.4rem,4.4vw,4.6rem)] font-light uppercase italic leading-[0.9] tracking-[0.02em] text-bone">{room.name}</h3>
          <p className="mx-auto mt-3 max-w-[26ch] font-mono text-[10px] uppercase leading-[1.9] tracking-[0.3em] text-bone/55">{room.text}</p>
          <button onClick={() => enterRoom(i)} className="pointer-events-auto mt-4 inline-block border-b border-bone/30 pb-1 font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.5em] text-bone/70 transition-colors duration-700 hover:border-bone hover:text-bone">Enter</button>
        </div>
      </Html>
    </group>
    </>
  )
}
export default function RoomWorlds() { return <><Room i={0} /><Room i={1} /></> }

'use client'
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react'
import { AUDIO } from '../lib/audio'
export default function SoundControl() {
  const [st, setSt] = useState({ running: false, muted: false })
  useEffect(() => { const id = setInterval(() => setSt(AUDIO.status()), 400); return () => clearInterval(id) }, [])
  const label = !st.running ? 'Enable sound' : st.muted ? 'Sound off' : 'Sound on'
  return <button onClick={() => { if (!st.running) { AUDIO.setMuted(false); AUDIO.resume() } else AUDIO.setMuted(!st.muted); setSt(AUDIO.status()) }} aria-label="Toggle sound" className="fixed bottom-[3vh] right-[3.5vw] z-[80] font-mono text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.4em] text-bone/45 transition-colors hover:text-bone">{label}</button>
}

<file path="components/SpecimenRoom.tsx">
'use client'
import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react'
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { P, introT, SPEC } from '../lib/progress'
import Specimens from './Specimens'
import { warnW, warnArm, warnB } from '../lib/warn'
import { sstep } from '../lib/math'
import { bake, fbm } from '../lib/procTex'

// The opening's containment chamber: dark brutalist concrete, enormous scale, lit only selectively (one faint overhead fixture, the brain's own rim lights,
// two small red warning lamps). It dissolves before the camera passes through the brain and is gone for the void. No UI graphics.
const soft = () => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = c.height = 128; const x = c.getContext('2d')!; const g = x.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 0, 64, 64, 64); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,1)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); x.fillStyle = g; x.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128); return new THREE.CanvasTexture(c) }
const sm = (a: number, b: number, x: number) => { const t = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (x - a) / (b - a))); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t) }
const V = (a: number[][]) => new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(a.map((q) => new THREE.Vector3(q[0], q[1], q[2])))
export default function SpecimenRoom() {
  const seen = useRef(0), g = useRef<THREE.Group>(null), mats = useRef<THREE.Material[]>([]), lights = useRef<{ l: THREE.Light; i: number }[]>([]), reds = useRef<THREE.Mesh[]>([])
  const o = useMemo(() => {
    const t = bake(512, 512, (u, v) => { const a = fbm(u * 6, v * 6, 1), b = fbm(u * 40, v * 40, 2, 3), seam = Math.min(Math.abs(Math.sin(u * Math.PI * 4)), Math.abs(Math.sin(v * Math.PI * 4))) < 0.02 ? 1 : 0, st = sm(0.5, 0.8, fbm(u * 3, v * 12, 4)), k = (0.12 + 0.07 * a + 0.03 * b) * (1 - 0.5 * seam) * (1 - 0.25 * st); return [k, k, k * 1.04, 0.85 - 0.15 * st, 0, 0.5 + b * 0.3 - seam * 0.3] })
    const mk = (rx: number, ry: number, rough = 1) => { const rep = (tx: THREE.Texture) => { const c = tx.clone(); c.wrapS = c.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping; c.repeat.set(rx, ry); c.needsUpdate = true; return c }; return new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: rep(t.map), roughnessMap: rep(t.orm), bumpMap: rep(t.bump), bumpScale: 2, roughness: rough }) }
    const cab = [[-0.5, 0.3], [0.6, -0.2], [-1.1, -0.6], [1.2, 0.5], [0.1, 0.9], [-0.3, -1]].map(([x, z], i) => V([[x * 2.2, 7, z * 2 + 0.5], [x * 1.2 + 0.4, 5.2 - i * 0.2, z + 0.4], [x * 0.5 + 0.2, 3.4, z * 0.5], [x * 0.3, 2 + (i % 3) * 0.1, z * 0.3]]))
    return { floor: mk(12, 12, 0.6), wall: mk(8, 3), col: mk(1, 4), cable: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#080808', roughness: 0.45 }), tex: soft(), cab }
  }, [])
  useFrame(({ clock }) => {
    const gr = g.current; if (!gr) return
    const w = warnW(), arm = warnArm(w), B = warnB(w), base = sm(1, 3.5, introT()) * (1 - sm(0.55, 0.8, P.value)), vis = Math.max(base, 0.22 * arm); gr.visible = vis > 0.003; if (!gr.visible) return
    const sv = SPEC.v !== seen.current; if (sv) seen.current = SPEC.v
    if (!mats.current.length || sv) gr.traverse((m: any) => { if (m.isMesh) { const ms = Array.isArray(m.material) ? m.material : [m.material]; ms.forEach((q: THREE.Material) => { if (!mats.current.includes(q)) { q.userData.b = q.opacity; q.transparent = true; q.needsUpdate = true; mats.current.push(q) } }) } else if (m.isLight && !lights.current.some((x) => x.l === m)) lights.current.push({ l: m, i: m.intensity }) })
    const specRev = sm(4, 8, introT()); mats.current.forEach((q) => { q.opacity = q.userData.b * vis * (q.userData.spec ? specRev : 1) }); lights.current.forEach((x) => { const c = (x.l as THREE.PointLight).color, red = !!c && c.r > 0.9 && c.g < 0.3; x.l.intensity = red ? x.i * (base * (0.8 + (P.reduced ? 0 : 0.2 * Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 1.1))) + arm * B * 5) : x.i * vis * (x.l.type === 'PointLight' && !P.reduced ? 0.8 + 0.2 * Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 1.1) : 1) })
    reds.current.forEach((m, i) => { (m.material as THREE.MeshBasicMaterial).opacity = Math.min(1, base * (0.55 + 0.35 * Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 1.1 + i)) + arm * B) })
  })
  return (
    <group ref={g} visible={false}>
      <mesh rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -3.4, -6]} material={o.floor}><planeGeometry args={[60, 60]} /></mesh>
      <mesh rotation={[Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, 7.2, -6]} material={o.wall}><planeGeometry args={[60, 60]} /></mesh>
      <mesh position={[0, 1.8, -17]} material={o.wall}><planeGeometry args={[44, 15]} /></mesh>
      {[-1, 1].map((s) => <mesh key={s} position={[s * 12, 1.8, -6]} rotation={[0, -s * Math.PI / 2, 0]} material={o.wall}><planeGeometry args={[44, 15]} /></mesh>)}
      {[3, -1, -5, -9, -13].map((z) => (<group key={z}>
        {[-6, 6].map((x) => <mesh key={x} position={[x, 1.9, z]} material={o.col}><boxGeometry args={[1.3, 11, 1.3]} /></mesh>)}
        <mesh position={[0, 6.9, z]} material={o.col}><boxGeometry args={[24, 0.6, 0.9]} /></mesh>
      </group>))}
      {[[-9, 3.5, -12], [8.5, 3, -14]].map(([x, y, z], i) => (<group key={i}><mesh position={[x, y, z]}><boxGeometry args={[0.25, 0.1, 0.1]} /><meshBasicMaterial color="#9fb8c8" transparent opacity={0.5} /></mesh><pointLight position={[x * 0.95, y, z + 0.5]} color="#8fa8b8" intensity={2} distance={9} decay={2} /></group>))}
      {[[-5.4, 5, -12.4], [5.4, 5, -12.4], [-5.4, 2, -4.4], [5.4, 2, -4.4], [0, -3.1, -16.7], [-11.4, 2.5, -9], [11.4, 2.5, -9]].map(([x, y, z], i) => <mesh key={`e${i}`} ref={(m) => { if (m) reds.current[2 + i] = m }} position={[x, y, z]}><planeGeometry args={[0.6, 0.6]} /><meshBasicMaterial map={o.tex} color="#ff2030" transparent opacity={0.5} blending={THREE.AdditiveBlending} depthWrite={false} /></mesh>)}
      <pointLight position={[-5, 4.5, -12]} color="#ff2030" intensity={1.2} distance={9} decay={2} /><pointLight position={[5, 1.8, -4.8]} color="#ff2030" intensity={1.2} distance={7} decay={2} />
      <Specimens />
      {o.cab.map((c, i) => <mesh key={i} material={o.cable}><tubeGeometry args={[c, 28, 0.045, 6, false]} /></mesh>)}
      {[-6, 6].map((x, i) => (<group key={x}>

<file path="components/ThreatWarning.tsx">
'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { sstep } from '../lib/math'
import { warnW, warnB, warnOut, warnArm, warnResidual } from '../lib/warn'

// THREAT RESPONSE DETECTED — typography unchanged. Entry: a thin red trace draws, the text forms with a 96→100% scale-up, fast fade-in and a bright pulse; then irregular
// intensity pulses; a pulse before a quick exit that leaves a tiny residual glow. The biological signal below responds to the same timeline.
const rh = (n: number) => { const x = Math.sin(n * 12.9898) * 43758.5453; return x - Math.floor(x) }
export default function ThreatWarning() {
  const root = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), text = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), glow = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), tiny = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), line = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  const wave = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null), r1 = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), r2 = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    const sig = (s: number, I: number) => { // laboratory monitoring trace: quiet baseline + sharp beats that crowd together and grow irregular as instability rises
      const sp = 26 - 14 * I, cell = Math.floor(s / sp), ph = s / sp - cell, amp = (0.5 + rh(cell) * 0.9) * (6 + 30 * I)
      let y = Math.sin(s * 0.1) * 2.5 * (0.4 + I) + (rh(Math.floor(s * 0.7)) - 0.5) * 3 * I
      y += ph < 0.1 ? ph * 10 * amp : ph < 0.2 ? -(0.2 - ph) * 10 * amp * 1.3 : 0
      if (I > 0.4) { const c2 = Math.floor(s / (sp * 0.5) + 3), p2 = s / (sp * 0.5) + 3 - c2; y += p2 < 0.12 ? p2 * 8 * amp * 0.5 * (rh(c2 + 5) > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) : 0 }
      return y
    }
    const fn = () => {
      const el = root.current; if (!el) return; const w = warnW(), on = w >= 0 && w < 2.05
      el.style.display = on ? '' : 'none'; if (!on) return
      const t = performance.now() / 1000, B = warnB(w), arm = warnArm(w), out = warnOut(w), entry = sstep(0, 0.05, w)
      if (text.current) { text.current.style.opacity = String(Math.min(1, B) * out * entry); text.current.style.transform = `scale(${0.96 + 0.04 * (1 - Math.pow(1 - sstep(0, 0.12, w), 3))})`; text.current.style.setProperty('--glow', String(0.6 + B * 0.6)) }
      if (r1.current && r2.current) { const sx = sstep(0, 0.08, w); r1.current.style.transform = r2.current.style.transform = `scaleX(${sx})`; r1.current.style.opacity = r2.current.style.opacity = String(out * Math.min(1, B)) }
      if (glow.current) glow.current.style.opacity = String(Math.min(1, 0.32 * B * arm * out + warnResidual(w))) // red light spill + the residual afterglow
      const tn = sstep(0, 0.2, w) * (1 - sstep(1.7, 2, w)); if (tiny.current) tiny.current.style.opacity = String(tn)
      if (line.current) { line.current.style.top = `${(w / 2) * 100}%`; line.current.style.opacity = String(0.14 * tn) }
      const c = wave.current?.getContext('2d'); if (c && wave.current) { // before: faint & stable · activates: amplitude + spikes · flashes: unstable · fades: weakens · then gone
        const I = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, 0.15 + 0.85 * Math.min(1, B) * arm)), ow = sstep(0, 0.06, w) * (1 - sstep(1.45, 1.85, w)), A = (0.25 + 0.75 * arm) * (1 - 0.6 * sstep(1.4, 1.8, w))
        c.clearRect(0, 0, 420, 56); c.strokeStyle = `rgba(200,30,45,${0.85 * ow})`; c.lineWidth = 1; c.beginPath()
        for (let x = 0; x <= 420; x += 2) { const y = 28 + sig(x + t * 70, I) * A * 0.9; x ? c.lineTo(x, Math.max(2, Math.min(54, y))) : c.moveTo(x, y) } c.stroke()
        if (wave.current) wave.current.style.opacity = String(ow)
      }
    }
    gsap.ticker.add(fn); return () => gsap.ticker.remove(fn)
  }, [])
  return (
    <div ref={root} style={{ display: 'none' }} className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-[26] font-mono" aria-hidden>
      <div ref={glow} className="absolute inset-0 opacity-0" style={{ background: 'radial-gradient(40% 32% at 50% 50%,rgba(190,15,30,.35),transparent 70%)' }} />
      <div ref={line} className="absolute inset-x-0 h-px bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-bone to-transparent opacity-0" />
      <div ref={tiny} className="absolute inset-0 text-[9px] uppercase tracking-[0.3em] text-bone/40 opacity-0">
        <p className="absolute bottom-[6vh] left-[4.5vw]">X 0.037 · Y 1.597 · Z 0.016</p>
        <i className="absolute left-[38%] top-[62%] h-2.5 w-2.5 border border-bone/50" /><i className="absolute left-[63%] top-[30%] h-1.5 w-1.5 border border-bone/30" />
      </div>
      <div className="absolute inset-0 grid place-items-center">
        <div className="text-center">
          <div ref={r1} className="mx-auto mb-6 h-px w-[min(46rem,80vw)] origin-center bg-[#b5121f]/70" style={{ transform: 'scaleX(0)' }} />
          <div ref={text} className="opacity-0">
            <p className="text-[clamp(2.2rem,7vw,7.5rem)] uppercase leading-[0.95] tracking-[0.1em] text-[#b5121f] [text-shadow:0_0_calc(18px*var(--glow,1))_rgba(200,20,35,0.5),0_0_2px_rgba(255,70,80,0.6)]">Threat response<br />detected</p>
            <p className="mt-6 text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.5em] text-[#9a1520]/80">Amygdala · signal elevated</p>
          </div>
          <div ref={r2} className="mx-auto mt-6 h-px w-[min(46rem,80vw)] origin-center bg-[#b5121f]/70" style={{ transform: 'scaleX(0)' }} />
          <canvas ref={wave} width={420} height={56} className="mx-auto mt-6 h-14 w-[420px] max-w-[80vw] opacity-0" />
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}
