'use client'
import { useMemo } from 'react'
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { bake, fbm, rnd } from '../lib/procTex'
import { sstep as sm } from '../lib/math'
import { E } from '../lib/enter'
import { H } from '../lib/progress'
import { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber'

const mix = (a: number, b: number, t: number) => a + (b - a) * t
const LEAF = ['#2a3a1c', '#3a4a22', '#4a3b1c', '#33261a'], mound = (x: number, z: number) => 0.32 * Math.exp(-(x * x + z * z) / 1.8)
// DEAR MOTHER — a heavy, leaning, partly buried grave marker: dense displaced slab (irregular edges, broken corner), weathering maps with the lettering carved into colour + bump (eroded, moss over some letters), earth mound, roots, vines and leaves as real geometry.
export default function Tombstone() {
  const o = useMemo(() => {
    const W = 1024, tc = document.createElement('canvas'); tc.width = tc.height = W
    const t = tc.getContext('2d')!; t.filter = 'blur(1.2px)'; t.fillStyle = '#fff'; t.textAlign = 'center'; t.textBaseline = 'middle'
    t.font = '500 150px "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif'; (t as any).letterSpacing = '14px'; t.fillText('DEAR', W / 2, W * 0.4)
    t.font = '500 128px "Cormorant Garamond", Georgia, serif'; t.fillText('MOTHER', W / 2, W * 0.55)
    const tm = t.getImageData(0, 0, W, W).data
    const stone = bake(W, W, (u, v, x, y) => {
      const a = fbm(u * 5, v * 18, 1), b = fbm(u * 24, v * 24, 2, 3), c = fbm(u * 4, v * 4, 3), base = 0.15 + 0.1 * b + 0.05 * c, stain = sm(0.5, 0.8, a) * 0.5
      const moss = sm(0.5, 0.72, fbm(u * 8, v * 8, 4, 3) * 0.8 + (1 - v) * 0.55 + Math.pow(Math.abs(u - 0.5) * 2, 3) * 0.2)
      const carve = (tm[(y * W + x) * 4 + 3] / 255) * (1 - 0.65 * sm(0.4, 0.62, fbm(u * 30, v * 30, 6))), k = (1 - stain * 0.5) * (1 - 0.6 * carve), m = moss * 0.85, mb = 0.6 + 0.8 * b
      return [mix(base * 1.04 * k, 0.06 * mb, m), mix(base * k, 0.095 * mb, m), mix(base * 0.88 * k, 0.03 * mb, m), 0.9, 0, 0.5 + (b - 0.5) * 0.4 - carve * 0.5 * (1 - m) + m * 0.1]
    }, (ctx, which) => { for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) { ctx.strokeStyle = which === 'map' ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)' : 'rgba(0,0,0,.8)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.beginPath(); let x = rnd(i, 1) * W, y = rnd(i, 2) * W * 0.5 + 100; ctx.moveTo(x, y); for (let j = 0; j < 14; j++) { x += (rnd(i * 20 + j, 3) - 0.5) * 70; y += 18 + rnd(i * 20 + j, 4) * 50; ctx.lineTo(x, y) } ctx.stroke() } })
    const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: stone.map, roughnessMap: stone.orm, roughness: 1, bumpMap: stone.bump, bumpScale: 5 })
    const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.9, 2.4, 0.4, 64, 80, 12), p = geo.attributes.position
    for (let i = 0; i < p.count; i++) {
      let x = p.getX(i), y = p.getY(i), z = p.getZ(i)
      if (y > 0.5) x *= Math.sqrt(1 - Math.min(0.98, ((y - 0.5) / 0.7) ** 2))
      const n = fbm(x * 3 + z * 2, y * 3 + z * 1.7, 8, 3) - 0.5, n2 = fbm(x * 9, y * 9 + z * 5, 9, 3) - 0.5, chip = sm(0.3, 0.75, x) * sm(0.55, 0.95, y)
      x += n * 0.05 + n2 * 0.02 - chip * 0.2; y += n * 0.04 - chip * 0.16; z += n2 * 0.04 + n * 0.03; x *= 1 - 0.04 * ((y + 1.2) / 2.4)
      p.setXYZ(i, x, y, z)
    }
    geo.computeVertexNormals()
    const gb = bake(512, 512, (u, v) => { const a = fbm(u * 10, v * 10, 1), b = fbm(u * 40, v * 40, 2, 3), m = sm(0.55, 0.75, fbm(u * 6, v * 6, 3)), l = sm(0.7, 0.8, b); return [0.06 + 0.05 * a + 0.05 * l - 0.02 * m, 0.045 + 0.04 * a + 0.03 * l + 0.03 * m, 0.03 + 0.03 * a + 0.01 * l, 1, 0, 0.5 + (b - 0.5) * 0.5] })
    const ground = new THREE.CircleGeometry(3.2, 64), gp = ground.attributes.position
    for (let i = 0; i < gp.count; i++) gp.setZ(i, mound(gp.getX(i), gp.getY(i)) + 0.05 * fbm(gp.getX(i) * 2, gp.getY(i) * 2, 3))
    ground.computeVertexNormals()
    const V = (v: number[][]) => new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(v.map((q) => new THREE.Vector3(q[0], q[1], q[2])))
    const vines = [V([[-0.8, -0.75, 0.25], [-0.75, -0.4, 0.23], [-0.5, -0.05, 0.225], [-0.55, 0.3, 0.23], [-0.25, 0.5, 0.235], [-0.1, 0.7, 0.23]]), V([[0.85, -0.75, 0.25], [0.8, -0.5, 0.23], [0.55, -0.1, 0.235], [0.62, 0.3, 0.23], [0.3, 0.18, 0.235], [0.35, -0.2, 0.23]]), V([[-0.45, -0.3, 0.235], [-0.1, -0.2, 0.23], [0.2, -0.28, 0.235], [0.5, -0.2, 0.23]])]
    const Y = -0.95, roots = [V([[0.5, -0.75, 0.3], [0.9, Y + 0.08, 0.8], [1.5, Y + 0.02, 1.3], [2, Y, 1.5]]), V([[-0.6, -0.75, 0.3], [-1, Y + 0.08, 0.7], [-1.6, Y + 0.02, 1.1], [-2.1, Y, 1.2]]), V([[0, -0.78, 0.35], [0.1, Y + 0.06, 1], [-0.2, Y + 0.02, 1.6]]), V([[-0.9, -0.7, 0], [-1.5, Y + 0.05, -0.5], [-2, Y, -0.9]])]
    const leaf = new THREE.Shape(); leaf.moveTo(0, -0.5); leaf.bezierCurveTo(0.6, -0.2, 0.6, 0.3, 0, 0.5); leaf.bezierCurveTo(-0.6, 0.3, -0.6, -0.2, 0, -0.5)
    const lg = new THREE.ShapeGeometry(leaf); lg.scale(0.16, 0.16, 0.16)
    const place = (n: number, fn: (i: number) => { p: THREE.Vector3; e: THREE.Euler; s: number; c: string }) => { const m = new THREE.InstancedMesh(lg, new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ roughness: 1, side: THREE.DoubleSide }), n), d = new THREE.Object3D(); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const r = fn(i); d.position.copy(r.p); d.rotation.copy(r.e); d.scale.setScalar(r.s); d.updateMatrix(); m.setMatrixAt(i, d.matrix); m.setColorAt(i, new THREE.Color(r.c)) } m.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true; return m }
    const vineLeaves = place(90, (i) => ({ p: vines[i % 3].getPointAt(rnd(i, 11)).add(new THREE.Vector3((rnd(i, 12) - 0.5) * 0.1, (rnd(i, 13) - 0.5) * 0.1, 0.02)), e: new THREE.Euler((rnd(i, 14) - 0.5) * 0.9, (rnd(i, 15) - 0.5) * 0.9, rnd(i, 16) * 6.28), s: 0.6 + rnd(i, 17) * 0.9, c: LEAF[Math.floor(rnd(i, 18) * 4)] }))
    const litter = place(60, (i) => { const an = rnd(i, 21) * 6.28, r = 0.8 + rnd(i, 22) * 1.8, x = Math.cos(an) * r, z = Math.sin(an) * r * 0.9 + 0.3; return { p: new THREE.Vector3(x, Y + mound(x, z) + 0.015, z), e: new THREE.Euler(-Math.PI / 2 + (rnd(i, 23) - 0.5) * 0.3, 0, rnd(i, 24) * 6.28), s: 0.7 + rnd(i, 25) * 0.8, c: ['#3a2a18', '#4a3a1c', '#2a1f12', '#33261a'][Math.floor(rnd(i, 26) * 4)] } })
    return { mat, geo, ground, gmat: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ map: gb.map, roughnessMap: gb.orm, roughness: 1, bumpMap: gb.bump, bumpScale: 3 }), vines, roots, vineLeaves, litter, soil: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#241a10', roughness: 1 }), vm: new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: '#2d2a1a', roughness: 1 }) }
  }, [])
  useFrame(({ clock }) => { o.vineLeaves.rotation.z = Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * 0.5) * 0.004 * (1 + 3 * (H.i === 1 ? 1 : 0)) })
  return (
    <group position={[0, 0.1, 0]} rotation={[0.02, 0.14, 0.05]}>
      <mesh geometry={o.geo} material={o.mat} />
      <object3D ref={(a) => { E.anchors[1] = a }} position={[0, 0.1, 0.2]} />
      <mesh geometry={o.ground} material={o.gmat} rotation={[-Math.PI / 2, 0, 0]} position={[0, -0.95, 0.3]} scale={[0.9, 2.3, 1]} />
      {o.vines.map((c, i) => <mesh key={i} material={o.vm}><tubeGeometry args={[c, 40, 0.018 + i * 0.004, 6, false]} /></mesh>)}
      {o.roots.map((c, i) => <mesh key={i} material={o.soil}><tubeGeometry args={[c, 30, 0.045, 7, false]} /></mesh>)}
      <primitive object={o.vineLeaves} /><primitive object={o.litter} />
    </group>
  )
}
</file>

'use client'
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { E } from '../lib/enter'

// Screen layers for the physical entry: rusted metal filling the frame (Canteen 66); soil closing in from below + light loss (Dear Mother).
export default function TransitionFX() {
  const metal = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null), dark = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null)
  useEffect(() => {
    const fn = () => {
      if (metal.current) metal.current.style.opacity = String(E.metal)
      if (dark.current) dark.current.style.opacity = String(E.dark * 0.45)
      document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--soil', String(E.soil))
    }
    gsap.ticker.add(fn); return () => gsap.ticker.remove(fn)
  }, [])
  return (<><div ref={dark} className="fx fx-dark" /><div className="fx fx-soil" /><div ref={metal} className="fx fx-metal" /></>)
}

<file path="components/Wordmark3D.tsx">
'use client'
import { useRef } from 'react'
import { Text } from '@react-three/drei'
import { useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber'
import { P, introT } from '../lib/progress'
import { sstep } from '../lib/math'

const rh = (n: number) => { const x = Math.sin(n * 127.1) * 43758.5453; return x - Math.floor(x) }
// Whole word, centred beneath the brain and partly behind it (the brain and its vessels occlude it). Rare, deterministic micro-instability: a sub-second tremor in ~1 of every 3 seven-second epochs.
export default function Wordmark3D() {
  const ref = useRef<any>(null)
  const { size } = useThree()
  const fs = (size.width / size.height) * 0.56
  useFrame(({ clock }) => {
    const m = ref.current; if (!m) return
    const p = P.value, t = clock.elapsedTime, big = sstep(0.1, 0.3, p)
    const ep = Math.floor(t / 7), ph = (t / 7 - ep) * 7, on = rh(ep) > 0.66 && ph > 1 && ph < 1.5, env = P.reduced || !on ? 0 : Math.sin(((ph - 1) / 0.5) * Math.PI)
    const jit = env * (Math.sin(t * 41) * 0.011 + Math.sin(t * 17.3) * 0.006)
    m.fillOpacity = (0.9 - 0.14 * env * Math.abs(Math.sin(t * 29))) * sstep(0.3, 3, introT()) * (1 - sstep(0.2, 0.34, p)); m.visible = m.fillOpacity > 0.004
    m.position.set((P.reduced ? 0 : Math.sin(t * 0.31) * 0.004) + jit, -1.25 + 1 * big, -1.5 - 1.5 * big)
    const ls = 0.1 + env * 0.006 * Math.sin(t * 19); if (Math.abs(ls - (m.letterSpacing ?? 0.1)) > 0.0015) { m.letterSpacing = ls; m.sync?.() }
    m.scale.set((1 + 4 * big) * (1 + 0.006 * env * Math.sin(t * 23)), (1 + 4 * big) * (1 - 0.004 * env), 1)
  })
  return <Text ref={ref} font="/fonts/cg-500.woff" characters="AMYGDREAD" fontSize={fs} anchorX="center" anchorY="middle" letterSpacing={0.1} color="#d8d0c6" material-toneMapped={false} fillOpacity={0}>AMYGDREAD</Text>
}
</file>

<file path="lib/audio.ts">
// Centralised Web Audio engine — fully procedural (no audio assets, nothing to download). One AudioContext, one set of persistent beds crossfaded by state,
// plus one-shot SFX. State machine: LOADING · LAB · BRAIN · DISINTEGRATION · WARNING · VOID · ROOM_DISCOVERY · CANTEEN · DEAR_MOTHER · BOOKING.
// Autoplay-safe: the context is only resumed after a user gesture; a tiny control shows until then.
export type AState = 'LOADING' | 'LAB' | 'BRAIN' | 'DISINTEGRATION' | 'WARNING' | 'VOID' | 'ROOM_DISCOVERY' | 'CANTEEN' | 'DEAR_MOTHER' | 'BOOKING'
export type AIn = { started: boolean; p: number; r: number; w: number; B: number; rev0: number; rev1: number; hover: number; room: number; booked: boolean; d: number; k: number }
const cl = (x: number, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, x)), rnd = (a: number, b: number) => a + Math.random() * (b - a)
const VOL = 0.55

class Engine {
  ctx: AudioContext | null = null; master!: GainNode; bus!: GainNode; momLP!: BiquadFilterNode; warnOsc!: OscillatorNode
  g: Record<string, GainNode> = {}; nodes: AudioScheduledSourceNode[] = []; buf!: Record<'white' | 'pink' | 'brown', AudioBuffer>
  muted = false; state: AState = 'LOADING'; next: Record<string, number> = {}; prevB = 0; lastAlarm = 0; warned = false

  init() {
    if (this.ctx || typeof window === 'undefined') return
    const AC = (window as any).AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext; if (!AC) return
    const c: AudioContext = (this.ctx = new AC())
    this.master = c.createGain(); this.master.gain.value = 0; const comp = c.createDynamicsCompressor(); comp.threshold.value = -20; comp.ratio.value = 4; this.master.connect(comp); comp.connect(c.destination)
    this.bus = c.createGain(); this.bus.gain.value = 0.8; this.bus.connect(this.master)
    const mk = (f: (i: number) => number) => { const b = c.createBuffer(1, c.sampleRate * 3, c.sampleRate), d = b.getChannelData(0); for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i++) d[i] = f(i); return b }
    let b0 = 0, b1 = 0, b2 = 0, last = 0
    this.buf = { white: mk(() => Math.random() * 2 - 1), pink: mk(() => { const w = Math.random() * 2 - 1; b0 = 0.99765 * b0 + w * 0.099046; b1 = 0.963 * b1 + w * 0.2965164; b2 = 0.57 * b2 + w * 1.0526913; return (b0 + b1 + b2 + w * 0.1848) * 0.2 }), brown: mk(() => { const w = Math.random() * 2 - 1; last = (last + 0.02 * w) / 1.02; return last * 3.5 }) }
    const osc = (t: OscillatorType, f: number) => { const o = c.createOscillator(); o.type = t; o.frequency.value = f; o.start(); this.nodes.push(o); return o }
    const noise = (k: 'white' | 'pink' | 'brown') => { const s = c.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = this.buf[k]; s.loop = true; s.start(); this.nodes.push(s); return s }
    const gain = (v: number) => { const g = c.createGain(); g.gain.value = v; return g }
    const bq = (t: BiquadFilterType, f: number, q = 1) => { const b = c.createBiquadFilter(); b.type = t; b.frequency.value = f; b.Q.value = q; return b }
    const lfo = (f: number, depth: number, p: AudioParam) => { const o = osc('sine', f), g = gain(depth); o.connect(g); g.connect(p) }
    const voice = (n: string, pan = 0) => { const g = gain(0); this.g[n] = g; if (pan) { const p = c.createStereoPanner(); p.pan.value = pan; g.connect(p); p.connect(this.master) } else g.connect(this.master); return g }
    // LAB bed: old clinical facility — mains hum, distant ventilation, room tone
    { const o = voice('hum'), f = bq('lowpass', 400); f.connect(o); [50, 100.3, 150.6].forEach((fr, i) => { const s = osc('sine', fr), g = gain(0.5 / (i + 1)); s.connect(g); g.connect(f) }) }
    { const o = voice('vent'), f = bq('bandpass', 350, 0.6); noise('pink').connect(f); f.connect(o); lfo(0.07, 120, f.frequency) }
    { const o = voice('room'), f = bq('lowpass', 500); noise('brown').connect(f); f.connect(o) }
    // BRAIN: very quiet low organic resonance + faint wet texture
    { const o = voice('brain'), t = gain(0.6); [55, 57.3].forEach((fr) => { const s = osc('sine', fr); s.connect(t) }); lfo(0.13, 0.3, t.gain); t.connect(o); const f = bq('bandpass', 900, 2), n = gain(0.08); noise('pink').connect(f); f.connect(n); n.connect(o); lfo(0.21, 300, f.frequency) }
    { const o = voice('pressure'); const s = osc('sine', 38), f = bq('lowpass', 90); s.connect(o); noise('brown').connect(f); f.connect(o) }
    // WARNING tone (rising electrical tone → unstable drone)
    { const o = voice('warn'); this.warnOsc = osc('sawtooth', 220); const f = bq('lowpass', 1200); this.warnOsc.connect(f); f.connect(o) }
    // CANTEEN bed: distant machinery, electrical buzz, wind through structure (left)
    { const o = voice('can', -0.5), m = osc('sawtooth', 55), f = bq('lowpass', 150), ag = gain(0.6); m.connect(f); f.connect(ag); ag.connect(o); lfo(0.5, 0.3, ag.gain); const h = osc('sine', 120), hg = gain(0.1); h.connect(hg); hg.connect(o); const w = bq('bandpass', 500, 1.2); noise('pink').connect(w); w.connect(o); lfo(0.05, 200, w.frequency) }
    // DEAR MOTHER bed: wind, leaves, earth (right) — through a low-pass used for the muffled underground
    { const o = voice('mom', 0.5); this.momLP = bq('lowpass', 700); this.momLP.connect(o); const w = bq('lowpass', 700), gg = gain(0.6); noise('pink').connect(w); w.connect(gg); gg.connect(this.momLP); lfo(0.06, 0.4, gg.gain)
      const lh = bq('highpass', 3500), lg = gain(0.04); noise('white').connect(lh); lh.connect(lg); lg.connect(this.momLP); lfo(0.9, 0.02, lg.gain); lfo(2.3, 0.015, lg.gain); const e = osc('sine', 44), eg = gain(0.5); e.connect(eg); eg.connect(this.momLP) }
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (!this.ctx) return; document.hidden ? this.ctx.suspend() : this.ctx.resume() })
  }
  resume() { this.init(); const c = this.ctx; if (c && c.state !== 'running') c.resume().catch(() => {}) }
  setMuted(m: boolean) { this.muted = m }
  status() { return { running: this.ctx?.state === 'running', muted: this.muted } }
  dispose() { this.nodes.forEach((n) => { try { n.stop() } catch {} }); this.nodes = []; this.ctx?.close().catch(() => {}); this.ctx = null; this.g = {} }

  private curve(k: number) { const n = 256, c = new Float32Array(n); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const x = (i / (n - 1)) * 2 - 1; c[i] = ((1 + k) * x) / (1 + k * Math.abs(x)) } return c }
  // one-shots
  private burst(kind: 'white' | 'pink' | 'brown', dur: number, vol: number, ft: BiquadFilterType, f0: number, f1: number, q = 1, delay = 0, dist = 0) {
    const c = this.ctx; if (!c || c.state !== 'running') return; const t = c.currentTime + delay, s = c.createBufferSource(); s.buffer = this.buf[kind]; s.loop = true
    const f = c.createBiquadFilter(); f.type = ft; f.Q.value = q; f.frequency.setValueAtTime(f0, t); f.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, f1), t + dur)
    const g = c.createGain(); g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol, t + Math.min(0.08, dur * 0.3)); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur)
    let n: AudioNode = f; s.connect(f); if (dist) { const w = c.createWaveShaper(); w.curve = this.curve(dist); f.connect(w); n = w } n.connect(g); g.connect(this.bus); s.start(t, Math.random() * 2); s.stop(t + dur + 0.05)
  }
  private tone(fr: number, dur: number, vol: number, type: OscillatorType = 'sine', to = fr, delay = 0, dist = 0) {
    const c = this.ctx; if (!c || c.state !== 'running') return; const t = c.currentTime + delay, o = c.createOscillator(); o.type = type; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(fr, t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, to), t + dur)
    const g = c.createGain(); g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, t); g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol, t + 0.01); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, t + dur)
    let n: AudioNode = o; if (dist) { const w = c.createWaveShaper(); w.curve = this.curve(dist); o.connect(w); n = w } n.connect(g); g.connect(this.bus); o.start(t); o.stop(t + dur + 0.05)
  }
  click(v = 0.05) { this.burst('white', 0.012, v, 'highpass', 2500, 4000) }
  relay() { this.click(0.04); this.tone(2200, 0.02, 0.02) }
  blip() { this.tone(1800, 0.05, 0.025); this.click(0.02) }
  metal(v = 0.04) { [420, 613, 1180].forEach((f, i) => this.tone(f * rnd(0.97, 1.03), 1.8 - i * 0.4, v / (i + 1))) }
  creak(v = 0.08) { this.burst('white', rnd(0.4, 0.9), v, 'bandpass', rnd(280, 380), rnd(110, 180), 12) }
  crackle(v = 0.05) { this.burst('white', 0.08, v, 'bandpass', rnd(1500, 3000), 800, 3, 0, 8) }
  thump(v = 0.2) { this.burst('brown', 0.5, v, 'lowpass', 160, 50); this.tone(90, 0.45, v * 0.6, 'sine', 40) }
  drip() { this.tone(900, 0.07, 0.03, 'sine', 480) }
  alarm() { this.tone(920, 0.11, 0.07, 'sine', 920, 0, 2); this.tone(1380, 0.11, 0.025, 'triangle') }
  surge() { this.thump(0.3); this.burst('white', 0.18, 0.09, 'bandpass', 2000, 900, 2, 0, 20) }
  whoosh(kind: 'air' | 'metal' | 'earth', dur = 1) { kind === 'air' ? this.burst('pink', dur, 0.1, 'bandpass', 900, 200, 0.8) : kind === 'metal' ? (this.burst('pink', dur, 0.3, 'bandpass', 400, 3800, 0.9), this.burst('white', dur, 0.06, 'highpass', 1500, 5000)) : this.burst('brown', dur, 0.3, 'lowpass', 600, 70) }
  // room entry, synchronised with the camera timelines in lib/enter.ts
  enter(i: number) {
    if (i === 0) { this.burst('pink', 0.5, 0.12, 'bandpass', 120, 600, 1, 0.1); this.whoosh('metal', 0.75); this.burst('pink', 0.75, 0.3, 'bandpass', 400, 3800, 0.9, 0.35); this.burst('white', 0.08, 0.35, 'highpass', 1500, 3000, 1, 1.05); [180, 420, 613].forEach((f, k) => this.tone(f, 0.9, 0.12 / (k + 1), 'sine', f, 1.05)); this.burst('brown', 0.45, 0.35, 'lowpass', 150, 50, 1, 1.05) }
    else { this.burst('brown', 0.9, 0.2, 'lowpass', 300, 900, 1, 0.1); this.burst('pink', 0.45, 0.2, 'bandpass', 200, 1200, 1, 1.0); this.burst('brown', 2, 0.35, 'lowpass', 600, 70, 1, 1.95); this.tone(40, 2, 0.12, 'sine', 40, 1.95); for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) this.burst('white', 0.1, 0.03, 'bandpass', 400, 250, 2, 2.2 + k * 0.35 + Math.random() * 0.2) }
  }
  leave() { this.burst('pink', 1.2, 0.12, 'bandpass', 1500, 300, 0.8) }

  stateOf(s: AIn): AState {
    if (!s.started) return 'LOADING'
    if (s.room >= 0) return s.booked ? 'BOOKING' : s.room === 0 ? 'CANTEEN' : 'DEAR_MOTHER'
    if (s.w >= 0 && s.w < 2.05) return 'WARNING'
    if (s.p < 0.12) return 'LAB'
    if (s.p < 0.32) return 'BRAIN'
    if (s.r >= 0.3) return 'ROOM_DISCOVERY'
    return s.w >= 2.05 ? 'VOID' : 'DISINTEGRATION'
  }
  private every(k: string, now: number, a: number, b: number, fn: () => void) { if (now > (this.next[k] ?? 0)) { if (this.next[k]) fn(); this.next[k] = now + rnd(a, b) } }
  update(s: AIn) {
    const c = this.ctx; if (!c || c.state !== 'running') return; const now = c.currentTime, st = (this.state = this.stateOf(s))
    const T = (n: string, v: number, tc = 0.7) => this.g[n]?.gain.setTargetAtTime(v, now, tc)
    let hum = 0, vent = 0, room = 0, brain = 0, press = 0, can = 0, mom = 0, momF = 700, q = 0
    switch (st) {
      case 'LOADING': hum = 0.25; room = 0.15; break
      case 'LAB': hum = 0.3; vent = 0.35; room = 0.3; break
      case 'BRAIN': hum = 0.25; vent = 0.25; room = 0.25; brain = 0.35; break
      case 'DISINTEGRATION': q = cl((s.p - 0.3) / 0.65); hum = 0.2; vent = 0.15 * (1 - q); room = 0.2; brain = 0.3 * (1 - 0.5 * q); press = 0.15 + 0.5 * q; break
      case 'WARNING': { const late = cl((s.w - 1.45) / 0.3); hum = 0.35 * cl(s.B) * (1 - late); press = 0.3 * (1 - late); room = 0.1 * (1 - late); break } // everything falls away: silence
      case 'VOID': break
      case 'ROOM_DISCOVERY': { const bc = cl((s.r - 0.25) / 0.1) * 0.12; can = Math.max(bc, s.rev0 * (0.42 + (s.hover === 0 ? 0.28 : 0)) * (s.hover === 1 ? 0.7 : 1)); mom = Math.max(bc, s.rev1 * (0.42 + (s.hover === 1 ? 0.28 : 0)) * (s.hover === 0 ? 0.7 : 1)); break }
      case 'CANTEEN': can = 0.5; hum = 0.12; break
      case 'DEAR_MOTHER': mom = 0.45; momF = 700 - 600 * s.d; break
      case 'BOOKING': if (s.room === 0) { can = 0.28; hum = 0.1 } else { mom = 0.22; momF = 250 } break
    }
    T('hum', hum); T('vent', vent); T('room', room); T('brain', brain); T('pressure', press); T('can', can); T('mom', mom); this.momLP?.frequency.setTargetAtTime(momF, now, 0.4)
    this.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(this.muted ? 0 : VOL, now, 0.5)
    // warning: tiny rising electrical tone → clinical alarm pulses locked to the flashes → instability → silence
    if (s.w >= 0) { const rise = cl(s.w / 0.1); this.warnOsc.frequency.setTargetAtTime(220 + 700 * rise + (s.w > 0.1 ? Math.sin(now * 9) * 30 : 0), now, 0.05); T('warn', s.w > 1.64 ? 0 : s.w < 0.1 ? 0.12 * rise : 0.05 * cl(s.B), 0.08)
      if (!this.warned && s.B > 0.9) { this.warned = true; this.surge() } if (s.B > 0.9 && this.prevB <= 0.9 && now - this.lastAlarm > 0.2 && s.w < 1.7) { this.alarm(); this.lastAlarm = now } this.prevB = s.B } else { T('warn', 0, 0.1); this.warned = false; this.prevB = 0 }
    // sparse one-shots: silence matters, small sounds mean something
    if (st === 'LOADING' || st === 'LAB' || st === 'BRAIN') { this.every('click', now, 6, 18, () => this.click(0.05)); this.every('metal', now, 20, 45, () => this.metal(0.035)) }
    if (st === 'DISINTEGRATION') { this.every('creak', now, 6 - 4.8 * q, 8 - 5.5 * q, () => { this.creak(0.05 + 0.1 * q); if (q > 0.3) this.crackle(0.04 * q) }); this.every('metal', now, 12, 25, () => this.metal(0.05)) }
    if (can > 0.2) { this.every('ccreak', now, 9, 22, () => (Math.random() > 0.5 ? this.creak(0.05) : this.metal(0.04))); this.every('crelay', now, 5, 12, () => this.click(0.035)) }
    if (mom > 0.2) { this.every('mcreak', now, 12, 28, () => this.creak(0.035)); this.every('mthump', now, 25, 50, () => this.thump(0.05)); if (st === 'BOOKING') this.every('drip', now, 4, 9, () => this.drip()) }
  }
}
export const AUDIO = new Engine()

import * as THREE from 'three'
import gsap from 'gsap'
import { H, LENIS } from './progress'
import { AUDIO } from './audio'

// State for the cinematic "enter room" sequences. Mutable + read per frame by CameraRig / RoomWorlds / TransitionFX (no React state).
const V = THREE.Vector3
export const E = {
  room: -1, busy: false,
  k: 0, k2: 0, d: 0, fov: 0, shake: 0, quiet: 0, dark: 0, soil: 0, metal: 0,
  sp: new V(), sl: new V(), cur: { a: new V(), b: new V() },
  anchors: [null, null] as (THREE.Object3D | null)[],
  booked: false,
  setBooking: (_: number | null) => {},
}
const AC = new V(), F1 = new V(), F2 = new V(), D = new V(), T = new V()
export const EF = new V() // depth-of-field focus during the sequence
const c01 = (x: number) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, x))

// Camera override: the CAMERA moves (the world and brain never rotate).
export function enterCam(a: THREE.Vector3, b: THREE.Vector3, t: number) {
  const anc = E.anchors[E.room]; if (!anc) return false
  anc.updateWorldMatrix(true, false); AC.setFromMatrixPosition(anc.matrixWorld)
  const front = (d: number, o: THREE.Vector3) => o.set(0, 0, d).applyMatrix4(anc.matrixWorld)
  if (E.room === 0) { // CANTEEN 66: pull back, then a hard rush at the casing's stencilled side, then rusted metal fills the frame
    front(3.2, F1); front(0.7, F2)
    a.lerpVectors(E.sp, F1, E.k); if (E.k2 > 0) a.lerp(F2, E.k2)
    b.lerpVectors(E.sl, AC, c01(E.k))
    a.x += Math.sin(t * 70) * 0.02 * E.shake; a.y += Math.cos(t * 83) * 0.015 * E.shake
    D.copy(b).sub(a).normalize(); T.copy(a).addScaledVector(D, 0.3); EF.lerpVectors(AC, T, E.k2)
  } else { // DEAR MOTHER: slow, accelerating approach, stop square to the carved words, hold, then descend in front of the grave
    front(1.35, F1); a.lerpVectors(E.sp, F1, E.k); b.lerpVectors(E.sl, AC, c01(E.k))
    D.copy(AC).sub(F1)
    if (E.d > 0) { a.y = F1.y - 4 * E.d; b.copy(a).add(D) }
    if (E.k >= 1) { a.x += Math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.004; a.y += Math.sin(t * 1.3) * 0.003 }
    T.copy(a).addScaledVector(D.clone().normalize(), 0.9); EF.lerpVectors(AC, T, E.d)
  }
  return true
}

const lock = (on: boolean) => { document.documentElement.classList.toggle('entering', on); on ? (LENIS.inst as any)?.stop() : (LENIS.inst as any)?.start() }
export function enterRoom(i: number) {
  if (E.busy || E.room >= 0) return // no double triggers, no second room
  E.busy = true; E.room = i; H.i = -1; E.sp.copy(E.cur.a); E.sl.copy(E.cur.b); lock(true); AUDIO.enter(i)
  const tl = gsap.timeline({ onComplete: () => { E.busy = false } })
  if (i === 0) { // CANTEEN 66 — decision, 0.25s coil, hard launch, impact, metal fills frame, booking powers on (~2.0s)
    tl.to(E, { quiet: 1, duration: 0.6, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0)
      .to(E, { k: -0.03, duration: 0.25, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0.1)
      .to(E, { k: 1, duration: 0.7, ease: 'power4.in' }, 0.35)
      .to(E, { fov: 1, duration: 0.55, ease: 'power2.in' }, 0.4).to(E, { fov: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out' }, 1.05)
      .fromTo(E, { shake: 1 }, { shake: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out' }, 1.05)
      .to(E, { k2: 1, duration: 0.65, ease: 'power3.inOut' }, 1.05)
      .to(E, { metal: 1, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.in' }, 1.3)
      .call(() => { E.booked = true; E.setBooking(0); history.pushState({ room: 0 }, '', '#canteen-66') }, [], 1.85)
  } else { // DEAR MOTHER — accelerating run, short stop square to the words, immediate descent into soil (~4.2s)
    tl.to(E, { quiet: 1, duration: 0.8, ease: 'power2.out' }, 0)
      .to(E, { k: 0.5, duration: 0.9, ease: 'power2.in' }, 0.1)
      .to(E, { k: 1, duration: 0.45, ease: 'power3.out' }, 1.0)
      .to(E, { d: 1, duration: 2, ease: 'power1.inOut' }, 1.95)
      .to(E, { soil: 1, duration: 1.6, ease: 'power1.in' }, 2.3).to(E, { dark: 1, duration: 1.8, ease: 'power1.in' }, 2.5)
      .call(() => { E.booked = true; E.setBooking(1); history.pushState({ room: 1 }, '', '#dear-mother') }, [], 3.9)
  }
}
// Reverse: canteen booking → camera reverses out; grave booking → light returns, camera rises back through the soil.
export function leaveRoom() {
  if (E.room < 0 || E.busy) return
  E.busy = true; E.booked = false; AUDIO.leave(); E.setBooking(null)
  gsap.timeline({ onComplete: () => { E.room = -1; E.busy = false; lock(false) } })
    .to(E, { metal: 0, soil: 0, dark: 0, duration: 1.1, ease: 'power2.inOut' }, 0)
    .to(E, { d: 0, k2: 0, duration: 1.5, ease: 'power2.inOut' }, 0.15)
    .to(E, { k: 0, quiet: 0, fov: 0, shake: 0, duration: 1.4, ease: 'power2.inOut' }, 0.8)
}

<file path="lib/materials.ts">
import * as THREE from 'three'
// Gentle, LOW-frequency tonal + roughness variation only. (The earlier version perturbed normals from screen-space derivatives of high-frequency noise and
// multiplied colour by thresholded noise: both read as black speckle. Removed.)
export function organic<T extends THREE.MeshPhysicalMaterial>(m: T, k = 110, amp = 0.12): T {
  m.onBeforeCompile = (s) => {
    s.uniforms.uK = { value: k }
    s.vertexShader = s.vertexShader.replace('#include <common>', '#include <common>\nvarying vec3 vP;').replace('#include <begin_vertex>', '#include <begin_vertex>\nvP = position;')
    s.fragmentShader = s.fragmentShader.replace('#include <common>', `#include <common>
varying vec3 vP; uniform float uK;
float h3(vec3 p){p=fract(p*.3183099+.1);p*=17.;return fract(p.x*p.y*p.z*(p.x+p.y+p.z));}
float vn(vec3 x){vec3 i=floor(x),f=fract(x);f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);return mix(mix(mix(h3(i),h3(i+vec3(1,0,0)),f.x),mix(h3(i+vec3(0,1,0)),h3(i+vec3(1,1,0)),f.x),f.y),mix(mix(h3(i+vec3(0,0,1)),h3(i+vec3(1,0,1)),f.x),mix(h3(i+vec3(0,1,1)),h3(i+vec3(1,1,1)),f.x),f.y),f.z);}`)
      .replace('#include <color_fragment>', `#include <color_fragment>\nfloat nz = .65*vn(vP*uK) + .35*vn(vP*uK*2.1); diffuseColor.rgb *= ${(1 - amp / 2).toFixed(3)} + ${amp.toFixed(3)}*nz;`)
      .replace('#include <roughnessmap_fragment>', '#include <roughnessmap_fragment>\nroughnessFactor = clamp(roughnessFactor + (nz-.5)*.22, .4, 1.);')
      .replace('#include <emissivemap_fragment>', '#include <emissivemap_fragment>\nfloat fres = pow(1. - clamp(dot(normal, normalize(vViewPosition)), 0., 1.), 3.); totalEmissiveRadiance += vec3(.1,.035,.03) * fres * .35;')
  }
  m.customProgramCacheKey = () => `organic${k}-${amp}`
  return m
}

<file path="lib/math.ts">
export const clamp = (x: number, a = 0, b = 1) => Math.min(b, Math.max(a, x))
export const sstep = (a: number, b: number, x: number) => { const t = clamp((x - a) / (b - a)); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t) }
export const bell = (a: number, b: number, c: number, x: number) => sstep(a, b, x) * (1 - sstep(b, c, x))
export function hash(str: string, seed = 0) { let h = 2166136261 ^ seed; for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) { h ^= str.charCodeAt(i); h = Math.imul(h, 16777619) } h ^= h >>> 13; h = Math.imul(h, 0x5bd1e995); h ^= h >>> 15; return (h >>> 0) / 4294967296 }

<file path="lib/pieces.ts">
import * as THREE from 'three'
import { hash } from './math'
export type Layer = 'cortex' | 'cerebellum' | 'deep' | 'tract' | 'vessel' | 'nerve' | 'amygdala' | 'hidden'
export interface Piece { mesh: THREE.Mesh; layer: Layer; home: THREE.Vector3; dir: THREE.Vector3; dist: number; start: number; dur: number; spin: THREE.Vector3; tremble: number; h: number }

export function classify(name: string, mat: string): Layer {
  const n = name.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, ' '), m = mat.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, ' ')
  if (m.startsWith('bone') || m === 'cartilage' || /tentorium|falx|dura/.test(n)) return 'hidden'
  if (/amygdal/.test(n)) return 'amygdala'
  if (m === 'artery' || /arter|sinus|vein|plexus|vessel/.test(n)) return 'vessel'
  if (m === 'nerve' || /nerve/.test(n)) return 'nerve'
  if (m === 'cerebellum' || /cerebell|vermis|flocculus|tonsil|medulla oblongata|\bpons\b|peduncle|colliculus/.test(n)) return 'cerebellum'
  if (m.startsWith('nucleus') || /nucle|^hippocamp|thalam|hypothal|putamen|pallid|caudate|ventric|mammillary|pituit|pineal|septum|claustr|substantia/.test(n)) return 'deep'
  if (m === 'white matter' || /tract|radiation|fasciculus|commissure|capsule|callos|fornix|cingulum|lemniscus|corona/.test(n)) return 'tract'
  return 'cortex'
}

// Recenters every mesh on its own pivot (so it can rotate in place) and assigns a deterministic
// separation recipe. The corridor the camera flies through is the local Z axis, so pieces spread radially from it.
export function buildPieces(root: THREE.Object3D) {
  const items: { mesh: THREE.Mesh; layer: Layer; c: THREE.Vector3 }[] = []
  const core = new THREE.Box3()
  root.traverse((o) => {
    const mesh = o as THREE.Mesh
    if (!mesh.isMesh) return
    const mm = mesh.material as THREE.Material
    const mat = ((mm?.userData?.name ?? mm?.name) ?? '') as string
    const layer = classify(((mesh.userData.name ?? mesh.name) ?? '') as string, mat) // GLTFLoader sanitises names; the original is in userData.name
    if (layer === 'hidden') { mesh.visible = false; return }
    const g = mesh.geometry
    if (!g.attributes.normal) g.computeVertexNormals()
    g.computeBoundingBox()
    const box = g.boundingBox!
    const c = box.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3())
    if (layer === 'cortex' || layer === 'cerebellum' || layer === 'tract' || layer === 'deep') core.union(box)
    items.push({ mesh, layer, c })
  })
  const center = core.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3())
  const size = Math.max(...core.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()).toArray())
  const pieces: Piece[] = items.map(({ mesh, layer, c }) => {
    const rad = mesh.geometry.boundingBox!.getSize(new THREE.Vector3()).length() / size
    mesh.geometry.translate(-c.x, -c.y, -c.z); mesh.geometry.computeBoundingSphere(); mesh.geometry.computeBoundingBox()
    mesh.position.copy(c); mesh.matrixAutoUpdate = true
    const k = mesh.name
    const h = hash(k, 1), h2 = hash(k, 2), h3 = hash(k, 3), h4 = hash(k, 4), h5 = hash(k, 5), h6 = hash(k, 6)
    const rel = c.clone().sub(center)
    const dir = new THREE.Vector3(rel.x, rel.y, rel.z * 0.2)
    if (Math.hypot(dir.x, dir.y) < size * 0.06) { dir.x = (h > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * size * 0.1; dir.y = (h2 - 0.3) * size * 0.1 }
    if (layer === 'cerebellum') dir.set(rel.x * 0.6, -size * 0.7, rel.z * 0.4)
    dir.add(new THREE.Vector3(h3 - 0.5, h4 - 0.5, (h5 - 0.5) * 0.3).multiplyScalar(size * 0.3)); if (dir.z > 0) dir.z *= 0.4; dir.normalize() // little motion toward the camera
    let dist = 0, start = 0.4
    const late = (1 - Math.min(1, rad * 4)) * 0.1 // large masses let go first, small ones later
    switch (layer) {
      case 'cortex': dist = 0.2 + 0.4 * h2; start = (h < 0.06 ? 0.34 : 0.42 + 0.18 * h2) + late; break
      case 'cerebellum': dist = 0.35 + 0.25 * h2; start = 0.44 + 0.1 * h + late; break
      case 'tract': dist = 0.15 + 0.3 * h2; start = 0.5 + 0.1 * h; break
      case 'deep': dist = 0.08 + 0.2 * h2; start = 0.55 + 0.08 * h; break
      case 'amygdala': dist = 0.06; start = 0.6; break
      case 'vessel': dist = 0.15 + 0.4 * h2; start = 0.4 + 0.2 * h; break
      case 'nerve': dist = 0.2 + 0.5 * h2; start = 0.42 + 0.2 * h; break
    }
    if (h6 < 0.3 || rad < 0.09) dist *= 0.2 // some pieces barely move
    let d = dist * size * 0.75, dur = 0.3 + 0.15 * h3
    // keep a clear corridor around the Z axis so the camera never meets raw geometry
    const rxy = Math.hypot(rel.x, rel.y), dxy = Math.max(0.35, Math.hypot(dir.x, dir.y)), R = 0.38 * size
    if (rxy < R) { d = Math.min(0.9 * size, Math.max(d, (R - rxy) / dxy)); start = Math.min(start, 0.38 + 0.12 * h); dur = 0.22 }
    const sp = (layer === 'deep' ? 0.4 : layer === 'vessel' || layer === 'nerve' ? 1.0 : 0.7) * 0.6
    return { mesh, layer, home: c.clone(), dir, dist: d, start, dur, spin: new THREE.Vector3((h4 - 0.5) * 2.4 * sp, (h5 - 0.5) * 2.4 * sp, (h6 - 0.5) * 2.4 * sp), tremble: size * 0.003, h }
  })
  return { pieces, center, size }
}
</file>

<file path="lib/procTex.ts">
import * as THREE from 'three'
const hs = (x: number, y: number, s: number) => { let h = Math.imul(x | 0, 374761393) ^ Math.imul(y | 0, 668265263) ^ Math.imul(s | 0, 2147483647); h = Math.imul(h ^ (h >>> 13), 1274126177); return ((h ^ (h >>> 16)) >>> 0) / 4294967296 }
const vn = (x: number, y: number, s: number) => { const xi = Math.floor(x), yi = Math.floor(y), xf = x - xi, yf = y - yi, u = xf * xf * (3 - 2 * xf), v = yf * yf * (3 - 2 * yf); const a = hs(xi, yi, s), b = hs(xi + 1, yi, s), c = hs(xi, yi + 1, s), d = hs(xi + 1, yi + 1, s); return a + (b - a) * u + (c - a) * v + (a - b - c + d) * u * v }
export const fbm = (x: number, y: number, s = 0, o = 4) => { let a = 0.5, f = 1, t = 0; for (let i = 0; i < o; i++) { t += a * vn(x * f, y * f, s + i * 17); f *= 2; a *= 0.5 } return t / (1 - Math.pow(0.5, o)) }
export const rnd = (i: number, s = 0) => hs(i, i * 7 + 3, s)
type Fn = (u: number, v: number, x: number, y: number) => number[] // r,g,b,rough,metal,bump (0..1)
// Bakes colour / roughness-metalness / bump maps from one procedural function (no image assets).
export function bake(w: number, h: number, fn: Fn, post?: (ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D, which: 'map' | 'bump') => void) {
  const mk = () => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h; const x = c.getContext('2d')!; return { c, x, d: x.createImageData(w, h) } }
  const A = mk(), B = mk(), C = mk()
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) {
    const o = fn(x / w, 1 - y / h, x, y), i = (y * w + x) * 4, q = (v: number) => Math.max(0, Math.min(255, v * 255))
    A.d.data[i] = q(o[0]); A.d.data[i + 1] = q(o[1]); A.d.data[i + 2] = q(o[2]); A.d.data[i + 3] = 255
    B.d.data[i] = 255; B.d.data[i + 1] = q(o[3]); B.d.data[i + 2] = q(o[4]); B.d.data[i + 3] = 255
    C.d.data[i] = C.d.data[i + 1] = C.d.data[i + 2] = q(o[5]); C.d.data[i + 3] = 255
  }
  A.x.putImageData(A.d, 0, 0); B.x.putImageData(B.d, 0, 0); C.x.putImageData(C.d, 0, 0)
  post?.(A.x, 'map'); post?.(C.x, 'bump')
  const t = (c: HTMLCanvasElement, srgb: boolean) => { const tx = new THREE.CanvasTexture(c); tx.colorSpace = srgb ? THREE.SRGBColorSpace : THREE.NoColorSpace; tx.anisotropy = 4; return tx }
  return { map: t(A.c, true), orm: t(B.c, false), bump: t(C.c, false) }
}

<file path="lib/scan.ts">
// The void is a breath, not a chapter. Timeline on room-phase progress r (scrubs both ways):
//  r<.04 brain exits · .04–.09 tiny system activity · .09–.23 THREAT RESPONSE DETECTED (brief) · .23–.3 darkness · .3→ two distant presences, then the rooms.
export type Phase = 'BRAIN' | 'VOID' | 'WARNING' | 'DARK' | 'ROOM_DISCOVERY'
export const phase = (r: number): Phase => r < 0.04 ? 'BRAIN' : r < 0.09 ? 'VOID' : r < 0.23 ? 'WARNING' : r < 0.3 ? 'DARK' : 'ROOM_DISCOVERY'

import { P, S } from './progress'
import { sstep, bell } from './math'
// One shared alarm timeline for text, waveform, lab lighting and dust. w runs 0→2 from the brain's ACTUAL state (S.remaining: fragments still in front of the camera),
// then room-phase progress. w<0 = inactive. Deterministic, scrubs both ways.
const rh = (n: number) => { const x = Math.sin(n * 12.9898) * 43758.5453; return x - Math.floor(x) }
export const warnW = () => { const prog = P.value > 0.85 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (0.3 - S.remaining) / 0.3)) : 0; return prog > 0.001 ? prog + P.r / 0.22 : -1 }
const KF: [number, number][] = [[0, 0], [0.03, 0.5], [0.07, 1.15], [0.11, 0.5], [0.16, 1.1], [0.21, 0.42], [0.26, 1.05], [0.29, 0.7], [0.32, 1.0], [0.4, 0.86]]
// brightness 0..1.3: on → bright → dim → bright → dim → bright → irregular flicker → settle; second small flicker; a pulse before the exit
export function warnB(w: number) {
  if (w < 0) return 0
  if (P.reduced) return w < 0.4 ? 1 : 0.9
  let b = 0.88 + 0.08 * Math.sin(w * 30)
  if (w < 0.4) { let i = 0; while (i < KF.length - 2 && w > KF[i + 1][0]) i++; const [a0, a1] = KF[i], [b0, b1] = KF[i + 1], t = (w - a0) / (b0 - a0); b = a1 + (b1 - a1) * Math.min(1, Math.max(0, t)); b += (rh(Math.floor(w * 220)) - 0.5) * 0.14 * sstep(0.05, 0.1, w) }
  if (w > 1.15 && w < 1.22) b *= rh(Math.floor(w * 160) + 7) > 0.4 ? 1 : 0.35
  return Math.max(0, b + 0.25 * bell(1.5, 1.56, 1.64, w))
}
export const warnOut = (w: number) => 1 - sstep(1.64, 1.86, w)                    // quick fade after the pre-exit pulse
export const warnArm = (w: number) => (w < 0 ? 0 : sstep(0, 0.15, w) * (1 - sstep(1.5, 2, w))) // how far the lab has "woken"
export const warnResidual = (w: number) => 0.25 * sstep(1.7, 1.78, w) * (1 - sstep(1.82, 1.98, w)) // tiny red glow after the text is gone

<file path="README.md">
# AMYGDREAD
`npm i && npm run dev`. Scroll timeline: lib/progress.ts (shared scroll state) → components/CameraRig.tsx (keyframes) + BrainModel.tsx (per-mesh separation, recipe in lib/pieces.ts) + Overlay.tsx (copy in lib/content.ts). Room copy in lib/content.ts is PLACEHOLDER. Sound is not implemented.
</file>
